   67: const COMMAND_WORDS: ExamQuestionCommandWord[] = [
   68:   "state",
   69:   "identify",
   70:   "define",
   71:   "describe",

   84: function isDifficulty(value: unknown): value is ExamQuestionDifficulty {
   85:   return value === "foundation" || value === "standard" || value === "higher";
   86: }
   87: 
   88: function isObjective(value: unknown): value is AssessmentObjective {
   89:   return value === "AO1" || value === "AO2" || value === "AO3";
   90: }
   91: 
   92: function isQuestionType(value: unknown): value is AssessmentQuestionType {
   93:   return (
   94:     typeof value === "string" &&
   95:     QUESTION_TYPES.includes(value as AssessmentQuestionType)
   96:   );
   97: }
   98: 
   99: function isCommandWord(value: unknown): value is ExamQuestionCommandWord {
  100:   return (
  101:     typeof value === "string" &&
  102:     COMMAND_WORDS.includes(value as ExamQuestionCommandWord)
  103:   );
  104: }
  105: 
  106: function isBlueprintItem(value: unknown): value is AssessmentBlueprintItem {
  107:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
  108:     return false;
  109:   }
  110: 
  111:   const item = value as Partial<AssessmentBlueprintItem>;
  112: 
  113:   return (
  114:     typeof item.id === "string" &&
  115:     typeof item.questionNumber === "number" &&
  116:     Number.isInteger(item.questionNumber) &&
  117:     item.questionNumber >= 1 &&
  118:     isObjective(item.assessmentObjective) &&
  119:     isQuestionType(item.questionType) &&
  120:     isCommandWord(item.commandWord) &&
  121:     typeof item.marks === "number" &&
  122:     Number.isInteger(item.marks) &&
  123:     item.marks >= 1 &&
  124:     item.marks <= 12 &&
  125:     isDifficulty(item.difficulty) &&
  126:     typeof item.topicFocus === "string" &&
  127:     item.topicFocus.trim().length > 0
  128:   );
  129: }
  130: 
  131: function isValidRequest(value: unknown): value is RequestBody {
  132:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
  133:     return false;
  134:   }
  135: 
  136:   const request = value as Partial<RequestBody>;
  137: 
  138:   return (
  139:     typeof request.topic === "string" &&
  140:     request.topic.trim().length > 0 &&
  141:     typeof request.qualification === "string" &&
  142:     request.qualification.trim().length > 0 &&
  143:     typeof request.examBoard === "string" &&
  144:     request.examBoard.trim().length > 0 &&
  145:     isDifficulty(request.difficulty) &&
  146:     (request.generationMode === "automatic" ||
  147:       request.generationMode === "manual") &&
  148:     Array.isArray(request.blueprint) &&
  149:     request.blueprint.length >= 1 &&
  150:     request.blueprint.length <= 20 &&
  151:     request.blueprint.every(isBlueprintItem) &&
  152:     (request.useDemo === undefined || typeof request.useDemo === "boolean")
  153:   );
  154: }
  155: 
  156: function slugify(value: string): string {
  157:   return value
  158:     .trim()
  159:     .toLowerCase()
  160:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
  161:     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  162: }
  163: 
  164: function titleCase(value: string): string {
  165:   return value
  166:     .trim()
  167:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  168:     .replace(/\b\w/g, (character) => character.toUpperCase());
  169: }
  170: 
  171: function createLevelDescriptors(marks: number): ExamQuestionLevelDescriptor[] {
  172:   if (marks < 6) {
  173:     return [];
  174:   }
  175: 
  176:   if (marks <= 8) {
  177:     return [
  178:       {
  179:         level: 3,
  180:         markRange: `${Math.max(6, marks - 2)}â€“${marks}`,
  181:         description:
  182:           "A detailed, accurate and well-developed response with clear application or evaluation and a supported conclusion where required.",
  183:       },
  184:       {
  185:         level: 2,
  186:         markRange: `3â€“${Math.max(4, marks - 3)}`,
  187:         description:
  188:           "A mostly accurate response with some developed reasoning, although coverage or evaluation may be uneven.",
  189:       },
  190:       {
  191:         level: 1,
  192:         markRange: "1â€“2",
  193:         description:
  194:           "Basic relevant statements with limited development, application or technical precision.",
  195:       },
  196:     ];
  197:   }
  198: 
  199:   return [
  200:     {
  201:       level: 4,
  202:       markRange: `${Math.max(10, marks - 2)}â€“${marks}`,
  203:       description:
  204:         "A comprehensive, technically accurate and balanced response with sustained reasoning, effective use of examples and a justified conclusion.",
  205:     },
  206:     {
  207:       level: 3,
  208:       markRange: `7â€“${Math.max(9, marks - 3)}`,
  209:       description:
  210:         "A mostly accurate and developed response with relevant analysis or evaluation, though balance or depth may be inconsistent.",
  211:     },
  212:     {
  213:       level: 2,
  214:       markRange: "4â€“6",
  215:       description:
  216:         "Some accurate knowledge and application, but development is limited and reasoning may be incomplete or one-sided.",
  217:     },
  218:     {
  219:       level: 1,
  220:       markRange: "1â€“3",
  221:       description:
  222:         "Basic relevant statements with little explanation, application or evaluation.",
  223:     },
  224:   ];
  225: }

  227: function createSpecificMarkScheme(
  228:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
  229:   points: string[],
  230: ): ExamQuestionMarkPoint[] {
  231:   if (item.marks >= 6) {
  232:     return points
  233:       .slice(0, Math.min(points.length, item.marks))
  234:       .map((description, index) => ({
  235:         id: `${item.id}-mark-${index + 1}`,
  236:         description,
  237:         marks: 1,
  238:       }));
  239:   }
  240: 
  241:   const selected = points.slice(0, item.marks);
  242: 
  243:   while (selected.length < item.marks) {
  244:     selected.push(
  245:       `Credit a further accurate, relevant and distinct point about ${item.topicFocus}.`,
  246:     );
  247:   }
  248: 
  249:   return selected.map((description, index) => ({
  250:     id: `${item.id}-mark-${index + 1}`,
  251:     description,
  252:     marks: 1,
  253:   }));
  254: }

  256: function demoContentForType(
  257:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
  258:   index: number,
  259: ): {
  260:   question: string;
  261:   context: string;
  262:   markPoints: string[];
  263:   modelAnswer: string;
  264:   examinerGuidance: string[];
  265:   misconceptions: string[];
  266: } {
  267:   const topic = item.topicFocus.trim();
  268: 
  269:   const variant = index + 1;
  270: 
  271:   switch (item.questionType) {
  272:     case "multiple-choice":
  273:       return {
  274:         question: `Which option gives the most accurate statement about ${topic}?\n\nA. ${topic} is used only for storing images.\nB. ${topic} is a Computer Science concept that can be applied to solve or represent problems.\nC. ${topic} removes the need for algorithms.\nD. ${topic} prevents computers from processing data.`,
  275:         context: "Select one answer.",
  276:         markPoints: [
  277:           `Award 1 mark for selecting option B: ${topic} is a Computer Science concept that can be applied to solve or represent problems.`,
  278:         ],
  279:         modelAnswer: "B",
  280:         examinerGuidance: [
  281:           "Award the mark only for the correct option.",
  282:           "Do not award multiple selections unless the final answer is clearly indicated.",
  283:         ],
  284:         misconceptions: [
  285:           `Believing that ${topic} has only one narrow use.`,
  286:           "Selecting an option because it contains familiar terminology rather than checking its accuracy.",
  287:         ],
  288:       };
  289: 
  290:     case "conversion":
  291:       return {
  292:         question: `Convert the value connected to ${topic} from one appropriate representation to another. Show each stage of your working.`,
  293:         context: `Use the value ${variant * 7 + 18} as the source value. The teacher may edit the representations before publishing.`,
  294:         markPoints: [
  295:           "Correctly identifies the place values or conversion method.",
  296:           "Shows an accurate intermediate stage.",
  297:           "Produces the correct final representation.",
  298:           "Uses the correct base, units or notation.",
  299:         ],
  300:         modelAnswer: `A complete answer should show the place values or repeated-division method, record the intermediate values accurately and give the final converted value with the correct notation.`,
  301:         examinerGuidance: [
  302:           "Award method marks where the process is correct but a later arithmetic slip occurs.",
  303:           "Require the final answer to use unambiguous notation.",
  304:         ],
  305:         misconceptions: [
  306:           "Reading a representation as if it were denary without considering its base.",
  307:           "Omitting leading zeros or notation when these are required by the question.",
  308:         ],
  309:       };
  310: 
  311:     case "calculation":
  312:     case "worked-calculation":
  313:       return {
  314:         question: `${titleCase(
  315:           item.commandWord,
  316:         )} a calculation involving ${topic}. Show all working and identify any important condition or error that could occur.`,
  317:         context: `Use two original values suitable for ${item.difficulty} difficulty. This is demo content, so the teacher should insert or edit the final numerical values.`,
  318:         markPoints: [
  319:           "Uses the correct method or operation.",
  320:           "Shows the first accurate stage of working.",
  321:           "Completes the remaining working accurately.",
  322:           "States the correct final answer.",
  323:           "Identifies a relevant condition such as overflow, range or validation where applicable.",
  324:           "Explains the effect of the identified condition.",
  325:         ],
  326:         modelAnswer: `The response should show the chosen values, apply the correct operation step by step, state the final result and explain any relevant limitation such as range or overflow.`,
  327:         examinerGuidance: [
  328:           "Credit correct working even if the final answer contains a single arithmetic slip.",
  329:           "Do not award a method mark for an unexplained guess.",
  330:         ],
  331:         misconceptions: [
  332:           "Applying a denary method without adapting it to the representation being used.",
  333:           "Ignoring carry, borrow, range or overflow conditions.",
  334:         ],
  335:       };
  336: 
  337:     case "complete-table":
  338:     case "truth-table":
  339:       return {
  340:         question: `Complete the missing entries in a table that assesses ${topic}.`,
  341:         context: `The final published version should contain ${Math.max(
  342:           2,
  343:           Math.min(8, item.marks),
  344:         )} missing cells and enough headings to make every required output clear.`,
  345:         markPoints: [
  346:           "Completes the first required row or cell accurately.",
  347:           "Completes the second required row or cell accurately.",
  348:           "Completes the third required row or cell accurately.",
  349:           "Completes the fourth required row or cell accurately.",
  350:           "Uses consistent notation throughout the table.",
  351:           "Derives the final output from the correct preceding values.",
  352:         ],
  353:         modelAnswer:
  354:           "The model answer should reproduce the completed table and briefly show how each output was obtained.",
  355:         examinerGuidance: [
  356:           "Award marks independently for each correct cell unless one error is carried forward consistently.",
  357:           "Accept equivalent Boolean notation where it is unambiguous.",
  358:         ],
  359:         misconceptions: [
  360:           "Treating AND and OR as if they produce the same output.",
  361:           "Changing an earlier input while calculating a later row.",
  362:         ],
  363:       };
  364: 
  365:     case "trace-table":
  366:     case "code-tracing":
  367:       return {
  368:         question: `Trace the supplied algorithm or code connected to ${topic} and record the value of each variable after every iteration.`,
  369:         context: `Use an original short algorithm with ${Math.max(
  370:           2,
  371:           Math.min(6, item.marks),
  372:         )} meaningful state changes.`,
  373:         markPoints: [
  374:           "Records the correct initial variable values.",
  375:           "Records the correct values after the first iteration.",
  376:           "Records the correct values after the second iteration.",
  377:           "Continues the trace accurately for the remaining iterations.",
  378:           "States the correct final output.",
  379:           "Uses a clear and consistent trace-table layout.",
  380:         ],
  381:         modelAnswer:
  382:           "The model answer should contain a fully completed trace table with one row per iteration and the correct final output.",
  383:         examinerGuidance: [
  384:           "Award follow-through marks when one early error is applied consistently.",
  385:           "Do not credit a final output with no supporting trace when the question requires working.",
  386:         ],
  387:         misconceptions: [
  388:           "Updating variables in the wrong order.",
  389:           "Forgetting that a loop condition is checked before or after an iteration.",
  390:         ],
  391:       };
  392: 
  393:     case "code-completion":
  394:       return {
  395:         question: `Complete the missing lines in an original program that uses ${topic}.`,
  396:         context:
  397:           "The code should use clear variable names and contain only the number of gaps justified by the mark allocation.",
  398:         markPoints: [
  399:           "Uses a correct statement or expression in the first gap.",
  400:           "Uses a correct statement or expression in the second gap.",
  401:           "Uses appropriate syntax for the selected programming language.",
  402:           "Preserves the intended control flow.",
  403:           "Produces the required output for the stated test data.",
  404:         ],
  405:         modelAnswer:
  406:           "The model answer should provide the completed code and a short explanation of how the inserted statements satisfy the requirements.",
  407:         examinerGuidance: [
  408:           "Accept logically equivalent code.",
  409:           "Ignore minor syntax errors only where the intended logic remains completely clear and the mark scheme permits it.",
  410:         ],
  411:         misconceptions: [
  412:           "Using assignment where comparison is required.",
  413:           "Placing a statement outside the required loop or selection block.",
  414:         ],
  415:       };
  416: 
  417:     case "debugging":
  418:       return {
  419:         question: `An original solution involving ${topic} contains errors. Identify the errors, correct them and explain why each correction is needed.`,
  420:         context: `Include at least ${Math.max(
  421:           1,
  422:           Math.min(4, Math.floor(item.marks / 2)),
  423:         )} distinct logical or syntax errors.`,
  424:         markPoints: [
  425:           "Correctly identifies the first error.",
  426:           "Provides a valid correction for the first error.",
  427:           "Correctly identifies the second error.",
  428:           "Provides a valid correction for the second error.",
  429:           "Explains how the corrected solution now meets the requirement.",
  430:           "Uses appropriate technical terminology.",
  431:         ],
  432:         modelAnswer:
  433:           "The model answer should quote or identify each faulty line, provide corrected code or logic and explain the effect of every correction.",
  434:         examinerGuidance: [
  435:           "Do not award a correction mark when the replacement creates a different error.",
  436:           "Accept alternative corrections that preserve the required behaviour.",
  437:         ],
  438:         misconceptions: [
  439:           "Changing code without explaining the original error.",
  440:           "Correcting syntax while leaving the underlying logic incorrect.",
  441:         ],
  442:       };
  443: 
  444:     case "algorithm-design":
  445:       return {
  446:         question: `Design an algorithm that applies ${topic} to solve the stated problem. Use pseudocode, structured English or a flowchart.`,
  447:         context: `Create an original scenario requiring input, processing, validation and output appropriate to ${item.difficulty} difficulty.`,
  448:         markPoints: [
  449:           "Identifies or accepts the required input.",
  450:           "Uses an appropriate process connected to the topic.",
  451:           "Uses correct sequencing.",
  452:           "Uses suitable selection or iteration where required.",
  453:           "Produces the required output.",
  454:           "Handles an important boundary or invalid case.",
  455:           "Uses clear variable names and unambiguous logic.",
  456:           "Provides a complete solution that meets the scenario.",
  457:         ],
  458:         modelAnswer:
  459:           "The model answer should provide a complete algorithm with clear inputs, ordered processing, any required selection or iteration, validation and the specified output.",
  460:         examinerGuidance: [
  461:           "Credit any logically correct algorithmic representation.",
  462:           "For higher bands, require a complete and robust solution rather than isolated fragments.",
  463:         ],
  464:         misconceptions: [
  465:           "Describing the desired result without giving an executable sequence of steps.",
  466:           "Using a loop or condition that can never terminate or be satisfied.",
  467:         ],
  468:       };
  469: 
  470:     case "compare":
  471:       return {
  472:         question: `Compare two appropriate approaches, representations or technologies connected to ${topic}.`,
  473:         context:
  474:           "The response must include similarities, differences and a judgement linked to a stated use case.",
  475:         markPoints: [
  476:           "States one accurate similarity.",
  477:           "States one accurate difference.",
  478:           "Develops the first comparison using technical reasoning.",
  479:           "Develops a second comparison using technical reasoning.",
  480:           "Links the comparison to the stated context.",
  481:           "Reaches a justified conclusion.",
  482:         ],
  483:         modelAnswer: `A complete answer should compare both options directly, explain at least two technically accurate similarities or differences, apply them to the scenario and justify which option is more suitable.`,
  484:         examinerGuidance: [
  485:           "Do not award full marks for two separate descriptions with no direct comparison.",
  486:           "A conclusion must follow from the evidence given.",
  487:         ],
  488:         misconceptions: [
  489:           "Describing only one option.",
  490:           "Giving a preference without technical justification.",
  491:         ],
  492:       };
  493: 
  494:     case "scenario-application":
  495:       return {
  496:         question: `Apply your knowledge of ${topic} to the original scenario provided. Explain the most suitable solution and its likely effect.`,
  497:         context: `A fictional organisation must make a decision involving ${topic}. Include constraints such as cost, performance, security or usability.`,
  498:         markPoints: [
  499:           "Identifies a relevant feature of the scenario.",
  500:           "Selects an appropriate concept or solution.",
  501:           "Explains how the solution applies to the scenario.",
  502:           "Explains one likely benefit.",
  503:           "Explains one limitation or risk.",
  504:           "Reaches a justified recommendation.",
  505:         ],
  506:         modelAnswer: `The model answer should select a suitable solution, connect each point explicitly to the scenario, explain benefits and limitations and finish with a justified recommendation.`,
  507:         examinerGuidance: [
  508:           "Generic textbook statements must be applied to the scenario to gain application marks.",
  509:           "Accept different recommendations when they are technically accurate and justified.",
  510:         ],
  511:         misconceptions: [
  512:           "Repeating information from the scenario without applying Computer Science knowledge.",
  513:           "Assuming that the most powerful or expensive option is always the most suitable.",
  514:         ],
  515:       };
  516: 
  517:     case "extended-response":
  518:     case "discuss":
  519:     case "evaluate":
  520:       return {
  521:         question: `${titleCase(
  522:           item.commandWord,
  523:         )} the role, benefits and limitations of ${topic} in the stated computing context. Reach a justified conclusion.`,
  524:         context: `Use an original scenario containing at least two competing considerations relevant to ${topic}.`,
  525:         markPoints: [
  526:           "Demonstrates accurate knowledge of the topic.",
  527:           "Explains a relevant benefit.",
  528:           "Develops the benefit using the scenario.",
  529:           "Explains a relevant limitation or risk.",
  530:           "Develops the limitation using the scenario.",
  531:           "Considers an alternative viewpoint or solution.",
  532:           "Uses accurate technical terminology.",
  533:           "Organises the response into a clear line of reasoning.",
  534:           "Makes a judgement based on the evidence.",
  535:           "Provides a justified conclusion linked to the scenario.",
  536:           "Maintains balance across the response.",
  537:           "Shows sustained analysis or evaluation.",
  538:         ],
  539:         modelAnswer: `A high-level response should explain the relevant principles of ${topic}, apply benefits and limitations to the scenario, consider alternatives and reach a balanced, technically justified conclusion.`,
  540:         examinerGuidance: [
  541:           "Use the level descriptors rather than counting isolated points for the final mark.",
  542:           "A one-sided response cannot access the highest level where balance is required.",
  543:           "Reward sustained reasoning, accurate terminology and scenario-specific judgement.",
  544:         ],
  545:         misconceptions: [
  546:           "Listing advantages and disadvantages without explaining their significance.",
  547:           "Giving a conclusion that is not supported by the preceding discussion.",
  548:         ],
  549:       };
  550: 
  551:     case "definition":
  552:       return {
  553:         question: `Define the term ${topic}.`,
  554:         context: "Use precise Computer Science terminology.",
  555:         markPoints: [
  556:           `States the essential meaning of ${topic}.`,
  557:           "Includes a second defining characteristic or accurate technical detail.",
  558:         ],
  559:         modelAnswer: `A complete definition should state what ${topic} is and include the technical characteristic that distinguishes it from related concepts.`,
  560:         examinerGuidance: [
  561:           "Do not credit an example on its own unless it demonstrates the defining meaning.",
  562:           "Accept equivalent technical wording.",
  563:         ],
  564:         misconceptions: [
  565:           "Giving an example instead of a definition.",
  566:           "Using the term itself within the definition without explaining it.",
  567:         ],
  568:       };
  569: 
  570:     case "explain":
  571:     case "short-response":
  572:     case "state-identify":
  573:     default:
  574:       return {
  575:         question: `${titleCase(
  576:           item.commandWord,
  577:         )} ${item.marks === 1 ? "one accurate feature" : "the key principles"} of ${topic}.`,
  578:         context: `Answer using accurate terminology and an example where appropriate. Variant ${variant} uses a distinct focus within the topic.`,
  579:         markPoints: [
  580:           `States an accurate point about ${topic}.`,
  581:           "Develops the point with a technically accurate explanation.",
  582:           "Provides a relevant example.",
  583:           "Explains how the example demonstrates the concept.",
  584:           "Links the explanation to a computing context.",
  585:           "Uses precise technical terminology.",
  586:         ],
  587:         modelAnswer: `A complete answer should state an accurate principle of ${topic}, explain why or how it works and use a relevant example to demonstrate understanding.`,
  588:         examinerGuidance: [
  589:           "Award separate marks only for distinct ideas.",
  590:           "A repeated point expressed differently should not be credited twice.",
  591:         ],
  592:         misconceptions: [
  593:           "Giving a vague statement without technical explanation.",
  594:           "Providing an example that is unrelated to the stated principle.",
  595:         ],
  596:       };
  597:   }
  598: }

  600: type TopicProfile = {
  601:   id: string;
  602:   patterns: RegExp[];
  603:   displayName: string;
  604:   definition: string;
  605:   explanation: string;
  606:   examples: string[];
  607:   benefits: string[];

 1383: function resolveTopicProfile(topic: string): TopicProfile {
 1384:   const matched = TOPIC_PROFILES.find((profile) =>
 1385:     profile.patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(topic)),
 1386:   );
 1387: 
 1388:   if (matched) {
 1389:     return matched;
 1390:   }
 1391: 
 1392:   return {
 1393:     id: "generic-computing",
 1394:     patterns: [],
 1395:     displayName: topic,
 1396:     definition: `${topic} is a Computer Science concept that should be defined using its purpose, main characteristics and relationship to a computing system or problem.`,
 1397:     explanation: `${topic} should be explained by identifying what it does, how it works, where it is used and the effect it has on data, software, hardware, users or a wider computing system.`,
 1398:     examples: [
 1399:       `a practical computing use of ${topic}`,
 1400:       `a scenario in which ${topic} solves or influences a problem`,
 1401:       `a comparison between ${topic} and an alternative approach`,
 1402:     ],
 1403:     benefits: [
 1404:       `a relevant advantage of ${topic} in the stated context`,
 1405:       "improved efficiency, accuracy, reliability, security or usability where technically appropriate",
 1406:       "support for solving the identified computing problem",
 1407:     ],
 1408:     limitations: [
 1409:       `a relevant technical or practical limitation of ${topic}`,
 1410:       "cost, complexity, security, reliability or usability constraints where appropriate",
 1411:       "dependence on correct design, implementation and testing",
 1412:     ],
 1413:     misconceptions: [
 1414:       `using the name ${topic} without explaining its technical meaning`,
 1415:       "giving a generic benefit without applying it to the question",
 1416:       "describing an example that does not demonstrate the concept",
 1417:     ],
 1418:     keywords: [
 1419:       "purpose",
 1420:       "process",
 1421:       "input",
 1422:       "output",
 1423:       "benefit",
 1424:       "limitation",
 1425:     ],
 1426:   };
 1427: }
 1428: 
 1429: function specificDefinition(topic: string): string {
 1430:   return resolveTopicProfile(topic).definition;
 1431: }
 1432: 
 1433: function specificExplanation(topic: string): string {
 1434:   return resolveTopicProfile(topic).explanation;
 1435: }
 1436: 
 1437: function specificExtendedAnswer(topic: string, contextLabel: string): string {
 1438:   const profile = resolveTopicProfile(topic);
 1439: 
 1440:   const benefitOne = profile.benefits[0];
 1441: 
 1442:   const benefitTwo = profile.benefits[1];
 1443: 
 1444:   const limitationOne = profile.limitations[0];
 1445: 
 1446:   const limitationTwo = profile.limitations[1];
 1447: 
 1448:   return `${topic} could be useful in ${contextLabel} because it can provide ${benefitOne}. It may also support ${benefitTwo}. For example, ${profile.examples[0]}.
 1449: 
 1450: However, ${limitationOne}. In addition, ${limitationTwo}. These limitations mean that the organisation should not adopt the approach without controls, testing and review.
 1451: 
 1452: A suitable alternative or safeguard is to introduce the system gradually, restrict access where appropriate, test it using representative data and maintain a fallback process. Staff or users should also receive guidance so that the technology is used correctly.
 1453: 
 1454: Overall, ${topic} should be used when its benefits clearly match the needs of ${contextLabel} and when the organisation can manage the identified risks. A controlled implementation with monitoring and regular review is more appropriate than unrestricted adoption.`;
 1455: }
 1456: 
 1457: function definitionForTopic(topic: string): string {
 1458:   return specificDefinition(topic);
 1459: }

 2229:     context: content.context,
 2230:     marks: item.marks,
 2231:     difficulty: item.difficulty,
 2232:     assessmentObjective: item.assessmentObjective,

 2236:     examinerGuidance: content.examinerGuidance,

 2241: function createDemoQuestionSet(request: RequestBody): GeneratedExamQuestionSet {
 2242:   const questionSetId = `${slugify(request.topic)}-${Date.now()}`;
 2243:

 2245:     (sum, item) => sum + item.marks,
 2246:     0,
 2247:   );
 2248: 
 2249:   return {
 2250:     id: questionSetId,
 2251:     title: `${request.examBoard}-style ${request.qualification} practice: ${request.topic}`,
 2252:     description:
 2253:       "Original exam-style practice generated from a teacher-controlled assessment blueprint.",
 2254:     qualification: request.qualification,
 2255:     examBoard: request.examBoard,
 2256:     topic: request.topic.trim(),
 2257:     difficulty: request.difficulty,
 2258:     generationMode: request.generationMode,
 2259:     questionCount: request.blueprint.length,
 2260:     totalMarks,
 2261:     estimatedTime: `${Math.max(10, Math.ceil(totalMarks * 1.2))} minutes`,
 2262:     copyrightNotice:
 2263:       "Independently generated practice material. It is not an official past-paper question and is not produced, endorsed or approved by any examination board.",
 2264:     blueprint: request.blueprint,
 2265:     questions: request.blueprint.map(createDemoQuestion),
 2266:     createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 2267:   };
 2268: }
 2269: 
 2270: function normaliseMarkScheme(
 2271:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
 2272:   markScheme: Array<{
 2273:     description: string;
 2274:     marks: number;
 2275:   }>,
 2276: ): ExamQuestionMarkPoint[] {
 2277:   const cleaned = markScheme
 2278:     .filter(
 2279:       (point) =>
 2280:         point.description.trim().length > 0 &&
 2281:         Number.isInteger(point.marks) &&
 2282:         point.marks >= 1,
 2283:     )
 2284:     .map((point, index) => ({
 2285:       id: `${item.id}-mark-${index + 1}`,
 2286:       description: point.description.trim(),
 2287:       marks: point.marks,
 2288:     }));
 2289: 
 2290:   if (cleaned.length === 0) {
 2291:     return createSpecificMarkScheme(item, [
 2292:       `Credit an accurate, relevant point about ${item.topicFocus}.`,
 2293:     ]);
 2294:   }
 2295: 
 2296:   const currentTotal = cleaned.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.marks, 0);
 2297: 
 2298:   if (currentTotal === item.marks) {
 2299:     return cleaned;
 2300:   }
 2301: 
 2302:   return createSpecificMarkScheme(
 2303:     item,
 2304:     cleaned.map((point) => point.description),
 2305:   );
 2306: }
 2307: 
 2308: function normaliseLevels(
 2309:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
 2310:   levels: Array<{
 2311:     level: number;
 2312:     markRange: string;
 2313:     description: string;
 2314:   }>,
 2315: ): ExamQuestionLevelDescriptor[] {
 2316:   if (item.marks < 6) {
 2317:     return [];
 2318:   }
 2319: 
 2320:   const cleaned = levels
 2321:     .filter(
 2322:       (level) =>
 2323:         Number.isInteger(level.level) &&
 2324:         level.level >= 1 &&
 2325:         level.markRange.trim().length > 0 &&
 2326:         level.description.trim().length > 0,
 2327:     )
 2328:     .map((level) => ({
 2329:       level: level.level,
 2330:       markRange: level.markRange.trim(),
 2331:       description: level.description.trim(),
 2332:     }));
 2333: 
 2334:   return cleaned.length > 0 ? cleaned : createLevelDescriptors(item.marks);
 2335: }

 2337: 
 2338: const LOW_QUALITY_QUESTION_PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
 2339:   /\bconnected to\b/i,
 2340:   /\bcalculation involving\b/i,
 2341:   /\bteacher (?:may|should) edit\b/i,
 2342:   /\bteacher should insert\b/i,
 2343:   /\buse two original values suitable\b/i,
 2344:   /\bfinal published version should contain\b/i,
 2345:   /\bapply your knowledge of .+ to the original scenario provided\b/i,
 2346: ];
 2347: 
 2348: function hasLowQualityQuestionWording(value: string): boolean {
 2349:   const cleaned = value.trim();
 2350: 
 2351:   if (cleaned.length < 12) {
 2352:     return true;
 2353:   }
 2354: 
 2355:   return LOW_QUALITY_QUESTION_PATTERNS.some((pattern) =>
 2356:     pattern.test(cleaned),
 2357:   );
 2358: }
 2359: 
 2360: function isGeneratedQuestionUsable(
 2361:   item: AssessmentBlueprintItem,
 2362:   generated: ParsedQuestion,
 2363: ): boolean {
 2364:   if (
 2365:     hasLowQualityQuestionWording(generated.question) ||
 2366:     hasLowQualityQuestionWording(generated.context)
 2367:   ) {
 2368:     return false;
 2369:   }
 2370: 
 2371:   if (
 2372:     !generated.modelAnswer.trim() ||
 2373:     generated.modelAnswer.trim().length < 8
 2374:   ) {
 2375:     return false;
 2376:   }
 2377: 
 2378:   const markTotal = generated.markScheme.reduce(
 2379:     (sum, point) =>
 2380:       sum +
 2381:       (Number.isInteger(point.marks) && point.marks > 0
 2382:         ? point.marks
 2383:         : 0),
 2384:     0,
 2385:   );
 2386: 
 2387:   if (markTotal !== item.marks) {
 2388:     return false;
 2389:   }
 2390: 
 2391:   if (
 2392:     item.marks >= 6 &&
 2393:     generated.levelDescriptors.length === 0
 2394:   ) {
 2395:     return false;
 2396:   }
 2397: 
 2398:   if (
 2399:     item.marks < 6 &&
 2400:     generated.levelDescriptors.length > 0
 2401:   ) {
 2402:     return false;
 2403:   }
 2404: 
 2405:   return true;
 2406: }

 2408: function createTopicKnowledgePrompt(topic: string): string {
 2409:   const profile = resolveTopicProfile(topic);
 2410: 
 2411:   return [
 2412:     `Curriculum knowledge for ${topic}:`,
 2413:     `Precise focus: ${profile.displayName}.`,
 2414:     `Definition: ${profile.definition}`,
 2415:     `Core explanation: ${profile.explanation}`,
 2416:     `Concrete examples: ${profile.examples.join(" | ")}.`,
 2417:     `Benefits where relevant: ${profile.benefits.join(" | ")}.`,
 2418:     `Limitations where relevant: ${profile.limitations.join(" | ")}.`,
 2419:     `Common misconceptions to avoid or assess: ${profile.misconceptions.join(" | ")}.`,
 2420:     `Preferred technical vocabulary: ${profile.keywords.join(", ")}.`,
 2421:   ].join("\n");
 2422: }
 2423: 
 2424: function buildQuestionSet(
 2425:   request: RequestBody,
 2426:   parsed: {
 2427:     title: string;
 2428:     description: string;
 2429:     estimatedTime: string;
 2430:     questions: ParsedQuestion[];
 2431:   },
 2432: ): GeneratedExamQuestionSet {
 2433:   const questionSetId = `${slugify(request.topic)}-${Date.now()}`;
 2434: 
 2435:   const questions = request.blueprint.map((item, index) => {
 2436:     const generated = parsed.questions[index];
 2437: 
 2438:     if (
 2439:       !generated ||
 2440:       !isGeneratedQuestionUsable(item, generated)
 2441:     ) {
 2442:       return createDemoQuestion(item, index);
 2443:     }
 2444: 
 2445:     return {
 2446:       id: `${questionSetId}-q-${index + 1}`,
 2447:       questionNumber: item.questionNumber,
 2448:       topic: item.topicFocus,
 2449:       questionType: item.questionType,
 2450:       commandWord: item.commandWord,
 2451:       question: generated.question.trim(),
 2452:       context: generated.context.trim(),
 2453:       marks: item.marks,
 2454:       difficulty: item.difficulty,
 2455:       assessmentObjective: item.assessmentObjective,
 2456:       markScheme: normaliseMarkScheme(item, generated.markScheme),
 2457:       levelDescriptors: normaliseLevels(item, generated.levelDescriptors),
 2458:       modelAnswer: generated.modelAnswer.trim(),
 2459:       examinerGuidance: generated.examinerGuidance,
 2460:       commonMisconceptions: generated.commonMisconceptions,
 2461:     } satisfies GeneratedExamQuestion;
 2462:   });
 2463: 
 2464:   const totalMarks = questions.reduce(
 2465:     (sum, question) => sum + question.marks,
 2466:     0,
 2467:   );
 2468: 
 2469:   return {
 2470:     id: questionSetId,
 2471:     title: parsed.title.trim(),
 2472:     description: parsed.description.trim(),
 2473:     qualification: request.qualification,
 2474:     examBoard: request.examBoard,
 2475:     topic: request.topic.trim(),
 2476:     difficulty: request.difficulty,
 2477:     generationMode: request.generationMode,
 2478:     questionCount: questions.length,
 2479:     totalMarks,
 2480:     estimatedTime:
 2481:       parsed.estimatedTime.trim() ||
 2482:       `${Math.max(10, Math.ceil(totalMarks * 1.2))} minutes`,
 2483:     copyrightNotice:
 2484:       "Independently generated practice material. It is not an official past-paper question and is not produced, endorsed or approved by any examination board.",
 2485:     blueprint: request.blueprint,
 2486:     questions,
 2487:     createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
 2488:   };
 2489: }
 2490: 
 2491: function createBlueprintPrompt(blueprint: AssessmentBlueprintItem[]): string {
 2492:   return blueprint
 2493:     .map((item) =>
 2494:       [
 2495:         `Question ${item.questionNumber}`,
 2496:         `Topic focus: ${item.topicFocus}`,
 2497:         `Assessment objective: ${item.assessmentObjective}`,
 2498:         `Question type: ${item.questionType}`,
 2499:         `Command word: ${item.commandWord}`,
 2500:         `Marks: ${item.marks}`,
 2501:         `Difficulty: ${item.difficulty}`,
 2502:       ].join("\n"),
 2503:     )
 2504:     .join("\n\n");
 2505: }

   39: function toStringList(
   40:   value: unknown,
   41: ): string[] {
   42:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   43:     return value.trim()
   44:       ? [value.trim()]
   45:       : [];
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
   49:     return [];
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   return value
   53:     .map((item) => {
   54:       if (
   55:         typeof item === "string"
   56:       ) {
   57:         return item.trim();
   58:       }
   59: 
   60:       if (
   61:         item &&
   62:         typeof item === "object"
   63:       ) {
   64:         const candidate =
   65:           item as Record<
   66:             string,
   67:             unknown
   68:           >;
   69: 
   70:         const text =
   71:           candidate.description ??
   72:           candidate.text ??
   73:           candidate.point;
   74: 
   75:         return typeof text ===
   76:           "string"
   77:           ? text.trim()
   78:           : "";
   79:       }
   80: 
   81:       return "";
   82:     })
   83:     .filter(Boolean);
   84: }

  227:               studentName:
  228:                 user.displayName ||
  229:                 "Student",
  230: 
  231:               studentEmail:
  232:                 user.email || "",
  233:             },
  234:           );
  235: 
  236:         setAssignment(
  237:           loadedAssignment,
  238:         );
  239: 
  240:         setSubmission(
  241:           loadedSubmission,
  242:         );
  243: 
  244:         setAnswers(
  245:           loadedSubmission.answers,
  246:         );
  247: 
  248:         setActiveQuestionNumber(
  249:           loadedSubmission.integrityLastQuestionNumber,
  250:         );
  251:       } catch (error) {
  252:         console.error(
  253:           "Unable to load written assessment:",
  254:           error,
  255:         );
  256: 
  257:         toast.error(
  258:           "The written assessment could not be loaded.",
  259:         );
  260:       } finally {
  261:         setLoading(false);
  262:       }
  263:     }
  264: 
  265:     void load();
  266:   }, [
  267:     params.assignmentId,
  268:     user?.uid,
  269:     user?.displayName,
  270:     user?.email,
  271:   ]);
  272: 
  273:   useEffect(() => {
  274:     return () => {
  275:       if (saveTimer.current) {
  276:         clearTimeout(
  277:           saveTimer.current,
  278:         );
  279:       }
  280: 
  281:       if (
  282:         countdownTimer.current
  283:       ) {
  284:         clearInterval(
  285:           countdownTimer.current,
  286:         );
  287:       }
  288:     };
  289:   }, []);
  290: 
  291:   const answeredCount =
  292:     useMemo(
  293:       () =>
  294:         answers.filter(
  295:           (answer) =>
  296:             answer.response.trim()
  297:               .length > 0,
  298:         ).length,
  299:       [answers],
  300:     );

  302:   async function logIncident(
  303:     type:
  304:       | "fullscreen_exit"
  305:       | "fullscreen_restored"
  306:       | "page_hidden"
  307:       | "page_visible",
  308:     detail: string,
  309:   ) {
  310:     if (
  311:       !assignment ||
  312:       !user?.uid
  313:     ) {
  314:       return;
  315:     }
  316: 
  317:     try {
  318:       await recordExamIntegrityIncident(
  319:         {
  320:           assignmentId:
  321:             assignment.id,
  322: 
  323:           studentId: user.uid,
  324: 
  325:           type,
  326: 
  327:           questionNumber:
  328:             activeQuestionNumber,
  329: 
  330:           detail,
  331:         },
  332:       );
  333:     } catch (error) {
  334:       /*
  335:        * The exam should remain usable even if an incident log write fails.
  336:        * Autosave/submission errors are handled separately.
  337:        */
  338:       console.error(
  339:         "Unable to record integrity incident:",
  340:         error,
  341:       );
  342:     }
  343:   }

  345:   async function terminateForIntegrity(
  346:     reason: string,
  347:   ) {
  348:     if (
  349:       !assignment ||
  350:       !user?.uid ||
  351:       finishingRef.current ||
  352:       locked
  353:     ) {
  354:       return;
  355:     }
  356: 
  357:     finishingRef.current = true;
  358: 
  359:     if (
  360:       countdownTimer.current
  361:     ) {
  362:       clearInterval(
  363:         countdownTimer.current,
  364:       );
  365:       countdownTimer.current =
  366:         null;
  367:     }
  368: 
  369:     setFullscreenCountdown(
  370:       null,
  371:     );
  372: 
  373:     setSaving(true);
  374: 
  375:     try {
  376:       await terminateExamForIntegrity(
  377:         {
  378:           assignmentId:
  379:             assignment.id,
  380: 
  381:           studentId:
  382:             user.uid,
  383: 
  384:           answers,
  385: 
  386:           questionNumber:
  387:             activeQuestionNumber,
  388: 
  389:           reason,
  390:         },
  391:       );
  392: 
  393:       setSubmission(
  394:         (current) =>
  395:           current
  396:             ? {
  397:                 ...current,
  398:                 status:
  399:                   "submitted",
  400: 
  401:                 answers,
  402: 
  403:                 integrityTerminated:
  404:                   true,
  405: 
  406:                 integrityTerminationReason:
  407:                   reason,
  408:               }
  409:             : current,
  410:       );
  411: 
  412:       if (
  413:         document.fullscreenElement
  414:       ) {
  415:         await document
  416:           .exitFullscreen()
  417:           .catch(() => undefined);
  418:       }
  419: 
  420:       toast.error(
  421:         "Exam terminated and submitted because the integrity rule was triggered.",
  422:       );
  423:     } catch (error) {
  424:       console.error(
  425:         "Integrity termination failed:",
  426:         error,
  427:       );
  428: 
  429:       finishingRef.current =
  430:         false;
  431: 
  432:       toast.error(
  433:         "The exam could not be submitted automatically. Please contact your teacher.",
  434:       );
  435:     } finally {
  436:       setSaving(false);
  437:     }
  438:   }

  440:   function beginFullscreenCountdown() {
  441:     if (
  442:       fullscreenExitActiveRef.current ||
  443:       !assignment ||
  444:       locked ||
  445:       finishingRef.current
  446:     ) {
  447:       return;
  448:     }
  449: 
  450:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current =
  451:       true;
  452: 
  453:     const seconds =
  454:       assignment.integrityPolicy
  455:         .fullscreenExitCountdownSeconds;
  456: 
  457:     setFullscreenCountdown(
  458:       seconds,
  459:     );
  460: 
  461:     void logIncident(
  462:       "fullscreen_exit",
  463:       `Fullscreen was exited. A ${seconds}-second return countdown started.`,
  464:     );
  465: 
  466:     let remaining = seconds;
  467: 
  468:     countdownTimer.current =
  469:       setInterval(() => {
  470:         remaining -= 1;
  471: 
  472:         setFullscreenCountdown(
  473:           Math.max(
  474:             remaining,
  475:             0,
  476:           ),
  477:         );
  478: 
  479:         if (remaining <= 0) {
  480:           if (
  481:             countdownTimer.current
  482:           ) {
  483:             clearInterval(
  484:               countdownTimer.current,
  485:             );
  486:             countdownTimer.current =
  487:               null;
  488:           }
  489: 
  490:           void terminateForIntegrity(
  491:             "The learner exited fullscreen and did not return within 5 seconds.",
  492:           );
  493:         }
  494:       }, 1000);
  495:   }
  496: 
  497:   function resolveFullscreenExit() {
  498:     if (
  499:       !fullscreenExitActiveRef.current
  500:     ) {
  501:       return;
  502:     }
  503: 
  504:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current =
  505:       false;
  506: 
  507:     if (
  508:       countdownTimer.current
  509:     ) {
  510:       clearInterval(
  511:         countdownTimer.current,
  512:       );
  513: 
  514:       countdownTimer.current =
  515:         null;
  516:     }
  517: 
  518:     setFullscreenCountdown(
  519:       null,
  520:     );
  521: 
  522:     void logIncident(
  523:       "fullscreen_restored",
  524:       "Fullscreen was restored before the five-second termination countdown expired.",
  525:     );
  526:   }
  527: 
  528:   useEffect(() => {
  529:     if (
  530:       !assignment ||
  531:       !user?.uid ||
  532:       locked ||
  533:       !integrityStarted ||
  534:       !assignment.integrityPolicy
  535:         .enabled
  536:     ) {
  537:       return;
  538:     }
  539: 
  540:     function onFullscreenChange() {
  541:       if (
  542:         finishingRef.current
  543:       ) {
  544:         return;
  545:       }
  546: 
  547:       if (
  548:         document.fullscreenElement ===
  549:         examRootRef.current
  550:       ) {
  551:         resolveFullscreenExit();
  552:       } else {
  553:         beginFullscreenCountdown();
  554:       }
  555:     }
  556: 
  557:     async function onVisibilityChange() {
  558:       if (
  559:         finishingRef.current ||
  560:         !assignment
  561:           ?.integrityPolicy
  562:           .monitorPageVisibility
  563:       ) {
  564:         return;
  565:       }
  566: 
  567:       if (
  568:         document.visibilityState ===
  569:         "hidden"
  570:       ) {
  571:         void logIncident(
  572:           "page_hidden",
  573:           "The exam page became hidden.",
  574:         );
  575: 
  576:         const action =
  577:           assignment
  578:             .integrityPolicy
  579:             .visibilityAction;
  580: 
  581:         if (
  582:           action ===
  583:           "auto_submit"
  584:         ) {
  585:           void terminateForIntegrity(
  586:             "The exam page became hidden and the teacher configured immediate automatic submission.",
  587:           );
  588: 
  589:           return;
  590:         }
  591: 
  592:         if (action === "pause") {
  593:           setIntegrityPaused(
  594:             true,
  595:           );
  596:         } else {
  597:           setIntegrityWarning(
  598:             "The exam page was hidden. This incident has been recorded.",
  599:           );
  600:         }
  601:       } else {
  602:         void logIncident(
  603:           "page_visible",
  604:           "The exam page became visible again.",
  605:         );
  606:       }
  607:     }
  608: 
  609:     document.addEventListener(
  610:       "fullscreenchange",
  611:       onFullscreenChange,
  612:     );
  613: 
  614:     document.addEventListener(
  615:       "visibilitychange",
  616:       onVisibilityChange,
  617:     );
  618: 
  619:     return () => {
  620:       document.removeEventListener(
  621:         "fullscreenchange",
  622:         onFullscreenChange,
  623:       );
  624: 
  625:       document.removeEventListener(
  626:         "visibilitychange",
  627:         onVisibilityChange,
  628:       );
  629:     };
  630:   }, [
  631:     activeQuestionNumber,
  632:     assignment,
  633:     integrityStarted,
  634:     locked,
  635:     user?.uid,
  636:   ]);

  167: function matchesFilter(
  168:   assignment: UnifiedAssignment,
  169:   filter: AssignmentFilter,
  170: ): boolean {
  171:   if (filter === "all") return true;
  172:   if (filter === "overdue") {
  173:     return isUnifiedAssignmentOverdue(
  174:       assignment,
  175:     );
  176:   }
  177:   if (filter === "resources") {
  178:     return (
  179:       assignment.kind === "resource"
  180:     );
  181:   }
  182:   if (filter === "quizzes") {
  183:     return assignment.kind === "quiz";
  184:   }
  185:   if (filter === "exams") {
  186:     return assignment.kind === "exam";
  187:   }
  188:   if (filter === "programming") {
  189:     return (
  190:       assignment.kind ===
  191:       "programming"
  192:     );
  193:   }
  194:   if (filter === "completed") {
  195:     return isUnifiedAssignmentComplete(
  196:       assignment,
  197:     );
  198:   }
  199:   if (filter === "submitted") {
  200:     return (
  201:       assignment.kind === "exam" &&
  202:       (assignment.status ===
  203:         "submitted" ||
  204:         assignment.status ===
  205:           "marking")
  206:     );
  207:   }
  208: 
  209:   return (
  210:     assignment.status === filter
  211:   );
  212: }

  371: export default function StudentAssignmentsPage() {

  377:     useState(true);

  379:     useState("");

  382:   const [filter, setFilter] =
  383:     useState<AssignmentFilter>("all");
  384: 
  385:   const loadAssignments =
  386:     useCallback(async () => {
  387:       if (!user?.uid) {

  401:         );
  402:       } catch (loadError) {

  404:           "Unable to load student assignments:",
  405:           loadError,

  407:

  409:

  411:           loadError instanceof Error

  414:         );

  417:       }

  419: 
  420:   useEffect(() => {

  423:

  449:               .includes(search);

  451:           return (
  452:             matchesFilter(
  453:               assignment,
  454:               filter,
  455:             ) && matchesSearch
  456:           );
  457:         },
  458:       );
  459:     }, [
  460:       assignments,
  461:       filter,
  462:       searchTerm,
  463:     ]);

  103:         qualification,
  104:         examBoard,
  105:       )
  106:     ) {
  107:       setError(
  108:         "This qualification and exam-board combination is not currently published.",
  109:       );
  110:       return;
  111:     }
  112: 
  113:     setSubmitting(true);
  114:     setSaved(false);
  115:     setError("");
  116: 
  117:     try {
  118:       await updateUserCourseSelection(user.uid, {
  119:         qualification,
  120:         examBoard,
  121:       });
  122: 
  123:       const refreshedProfile = await refreshProfile();
  124: 
  125:       if (
  126:         !refreshedProfile ||
  127:         refreshedProfile.qualification !== qualification ||
  128:         refreshedProfile.examBoard !== examBoard ||
  129:         refreshedProfile.onboardingComplete !== true
  130:       ) {
  131:         throw new Error(
  132:           "The curriculum was saved, but the updated profile could not be confirmed.",
  133:         );
  134:       }
  135: 
  136:       setSaved(true);
  137: 
  138:       router.replace("/learn");
  139:     } catch (caughtError) {
  140:       console.error("Unable to update curriculum:", caughtError);
  141: 
  142:       setError(
  143:         caughtError instanceof Error
  144:           ? caughtError.message
  145:           : "Your curriculum could not be updated.",
  146:       );
  147:     } finally {
  148:       setSubmitting(false);
  149:     }
  150:   }
  151: 
  152:   if (loading || (user && !profileReady && !profileError)) {
  153:     return (
  154:       <div className="flex min-h-[60vh] items-center justify-center">
  155:         <div className="text-center">
  156:           <div className="mx-auto h-12 w-12 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-blue-100 border-t-blue-600" />
  157: 
  158:           <p className="mt-4 font-bold text-slate-700">
  159:             Loading curriculum settings...
  160:           </p>
  161:         </div>
  162:       </div>
  163:     );
  164:   }
  165: 
  166:   return (
  167:     <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-8">
  168:       <section className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 shadow-sm md:p-10">
  169:         <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-6 md:flex-row md:items-start">
  170:           <div>
  171:             <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600">
  172:               Curriculum settings
  173:             </p>
  174: 
  175:             <h1 className="mt-2 text-4xl font-black text-slate-950">
  176:               Change your Computer Science course
  177:             </h1>
  178: 
  179:             <p className="mt-4 max-w-3xl leading-7 text-slate-600">
  180:               Your selection controls the units, topics, lessons, quizzes and
  181:               exam-board content shown throughout CS Master.
  182:             </p>
  183:           </div>
  184: 
  185:           <Link
  186:             href="/learn"
  187:             className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-5 py-3 font-black text-slate-700 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
  188:           >
  189:             Back to Learn
  190:           </Link>
  191:         </div>
  192: 
  193:         {error && (
  194:           <div
  195:             role="alert"
  196:             className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 font-semibold text-red-800"
  197:           >
  198:             {error}
  199:           </div>
  200:         )}
  201: 
  202:         {saved && (
  203:           <div
  204:             role="status"
  205:             className="mt-6 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 font-semibold text-emerald-800"
  206:           >
  207:             Your curriculum has been updated.
  208:           </div>
  209:         )}
  210: 
  211:         <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-10 space-y-10">
  212:           <fieldset>
  213:             <legend className="text-xl font-black text-slate-950">
  214:               1. Qualification
  215:             </legend>
  216: 
  217:             <div className="mt-5 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
  218:               {qualificationOptions.map((option) => {
  219:                 const selected = qualification === option.value;
  220: 
  221:                 return (
  222:                   <label
  223:                     key={option.value}
  224:                     className={`cursor-pointer rounded-2xl border-2 p-6 transition ${
  225:                       selected

  228:                     }`}
  229:                   >
  230:                     <input
  231:                       type="radio"
  232:                       name="qualification"

  242:                           {option.title}
  243:                         </p>
  244:

  246:                           {option.description}

  248:                       </div>
  249:

  251:                         className={`mt-1 h-6 w-6 shrink-0 rounded-full border-2 ${
  252:                           selected
  253:                             ? "border-blue-600 bg-blue-600 ring-4 ring-blue-100"
  254:                             : "border-slate-300"
  255:                         }`}
  256:                       />
  257:                     </div>
  258:                   </label>

  261:             </div>

  263: 
  264:           <fieldset>
  265:             <legend className="text-xl font-black text-slate-950">
  266:               2. Exam board
  267:             </legend>
  268:

  270:               {examBoardOptions.map((option) => {
  271:                 const selected = examBoard === option.value;
  272: 
  273:                 return (
  274:                   <label
  275:                     key={option.value}
  276:                     className={`cursor-pointer rounded-2xl border-2 p-6 transition ${
  277:                       selected
  278:                         ? "border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50"
  279:                         : "border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-indigo-300"
  280:                     }`}
  281:                   >
  282:                     <input
  283:                       type="radio"
  284:                       name="examBoard"
  285:                       value={option.value}
  286:                       checked={selected}
  287:                       onChange={() => setExamBoard(option.value)}
  288:                       className="sr-only"
  289:                     />
  290: 
  291:                     <p className="text-xl font-black text-slate-950">
  292:                       {option.title}
  293:                     </p>
  294: 
  295:                     <p className="mt-2 leading-7 text-slate-600">
  296:                       {option.description}
  297:                     </p>
  298:                   </label>
  299:                 );
  300:               })}
  301:             </div>
  302:           </fieldset>
  303: 
  304:           {!getCurriculumDefinition(
  305:             qualification,
  306:             examBoard,
  307:           ) && (
  308:             <div className="rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-5 font-semibold text-amber-900">
  309:               This qualification and exam-board combination is not currently
  310:               published in CS Master. Choose an available curriculum.
  311:             </div>
  312:           )}
  313: 
  314:           <button
  315:             type="submit"
  316:             disabled={
  317:               submitting ||
  318:               !getCurriculumDefinition(
  319:                 qualification,
  320:                 examBoard,
  321:               )
  322:             }
  323:             className="w-full rounded-2xl bg-blue-600 px-6 py-4 text-lg font-black text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300"
  324:           >
  325:             {submitting ? "Updating curriculum..." : "Save curriculum"}
  326:           </button>
  327:         </form>
  328:       </section>
  329:     </div>
  330:   );
  331: }

   46: function normaliseLookupValue(
   47:   value: string,
   48: ): string {
   49:   return value
   50:     .trim()
   51:     .toLowerCase()
   52:     .replace(/&/g, "and")
   53:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
   54:     .trim();
   55: }
   56: 
   57: /*
   58:  * Query strings may contain either:
   59:  *
   60:  *   /quiz?topic=binary
   61:  *
   62:  * or a human-readable adaptive-learning topic:
   63:  *
   64:  *   /quiz?topic=Binary%20Numbers
   65:  *
   66:  * Resolve both forms through the canonical curriculum registry.
   67:  */
   68: function resolveCurriculumTopicId(
   69:   value: string,
   70: ): string | null {
   71:   const cleaned =
   72:     normaliseLookupValue(value);
   73: 
   74:   if (!cleaned) {
   75:     return null;
   76:   }
   77: 
   78:   const match =
   79:     curriculumRegistry.find(
   80:       (topic) => {
   81:         const searchable = [
   82:           topic.id,
   83:           topic.title,
   84:           ...(topic.aliases || []),
   85:         ].map(
   86:           normaliseLookupValue,
   87:         );
   88: 
   89:         return searchable.includes(
   90:           cleaned,
   91:         );
   92:       },
   93:     );
   94: 
   95:   return match?.id || null;
   96: }

    4: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
    5: import Skeleton from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
    6: import RevisionPlanCard from "@/components/revision-plan/RevisionPlanCard";
    7: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
    8: import { getStudentInterventions } from "@/services/interventionService";
    9: import type { Intervention } from "@/types/intervention";
   10: export default function RevisionPlanPage() {
   11:   const { user } = useAuth();
   12:   const userId = user?.uid;
   13:   const [items, setItems] = useState<Intervention[]>([]);
   14:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   15: 
   16:   const load = useCallback(async () => {
   17:     if (!userId) return;
   18:     setLoading(true);
   19:     try {
   20:       setItems(await getStudentInterventions(userId));
   21:     } finally {
   22:       setLoading(false);
   23:     }
   24:   }, [userId]);
   25: 
   26:   useEffect(() => {
   27:     void load();
   28:   }, [load]);
   29:   if (loading)
   30:     return (
   31:       <div className="space-y-6">
   32:         <Skeleton className="h-48" />
   33:         <Skeleton className="h-96" />
   34:       </div>
   35:     );
   36:   const active = items.filter((i) => i.status === "active");
   37:   const completed = items.filter((i) => i.status === "completed");
   38:   return (
   39:     <div className="space-y-8">
   40:       <Card className="border-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900 to-teal-800 text-white">

   59:               href="/dashboard"

   69: function gradeGapLabel(value: number | null): string {

   71:     return "Target not set";

   75:     return `+${value} above target`;

   79:     return "On target";

  591:             <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600">

  670: function TopicPanel({
  671:   title,
  672:   subtitle,
  673:   topics,
  674:   positive,
  675: }: {
  676:   title: string;
  677:   subtitle: string;
  678:   topics: TeacherAnalyticsActionCentre["priorityTopics"];
  679:   positive: boolean;
  680: }) {
  681:   return (
  682:     <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6">

  684:         <div className={`rounded-2xl p-3 ${positive ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" : "bg-red-50 text-red-700"}`}>
  685:           {positive ? <TrendingUp className="h-5 w-5" /> : <Target className="h-5 w-5" />}

  691:         </div>
  692:       </div>
  693: 
  694:       {topics.length === 0 ? (
  695:         <p className="mt-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-5 text-sm text-slate-500">
  696:           More assessed evidence is needed before topic patterns can be shown.
  697:         </p>

  702:               <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
  703:                 <div>
  704:                   <p className="font-black text-slate-900">{topic.topic}</p>
  705:                   <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
  706:                     {topic.evidenceCount} evidence item{topic.evidenceCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} Â· {topic.studentCount} learner{topic.studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}
  707:                   </p>
  708:                 </div>
  709:                 <p className={`text-xl font-black ${positive ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-red-700"}`}>
  710:                   {topic.weightedPercentage}%
  711:                 </p>
  712:               </div>
  713: 
  714:               <div className="mt-3 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-200">
  715:                 <div
  716:                   className="h-full rounded-full bg-current"
  717:                   style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, topic.weightedPercentage))}%` }}
  718:                 />
  719:               </div>
  720:             </div>
  721:           ))}
  722:         </div>
  723:       )}
  724:     </Card>
  725:   );

  728: function ClassIntelligenceCard({
  729:   classItem,
  730: }: {
  731:   classItem: TeacherActionClass;
  732: }) {
  733:   const coverage =
  734:     classItem.studentCount > 0
  735:       ? Math.round((classItem.studentsWithEvidence / classItem.studentCount) * 100)
  736:       : 0;
  737: 
  738:   return (
  739:     <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6">
  740:       <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
  741:         <div>
  742:           <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-teal-600">
  743:             {classItem.yearGroup || "Teaching group"}
  744:           </p>
  745:           <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-black text-slate-950">{classItem.className}</h3>
  746:         </div>
  747: 
  748:         <Link
  749:           href={`/teacher/classes/${classItem.classId}`}
  750:           className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-black text-blue-700"
  751:         >
  752:           Open class
  753:           <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
  754:         </Link>
  755:       </div>
  756: 
  757:       <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4">
  758:         <ClassMetric label="Working" value={classItem.averageWorkingGrade} icon={<Gauge className="h-4 w-4" />} />
  759:         <ClassMetric label="Target" value={classItem.averageTargetGrade} icon={<Target className="h-4 w-4" />} />
  760:         <ClassMetric label="Completion" value={`${classItem.averageCompletionRate}%`} icon={<CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />} />
  761:         <ClassMetric label="On / above target" value={`${classItem.onOrAboveTargetPercentage}%`} icon={<BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4" />} />
  762:       </div>

   54: function formatDate(value: Date | null, includeTime = false): string {
   55:   if (!value) {
   56:     return "â€”";
   57:   }
   58: 
   59:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
   60:     "en-GB",
   61:     includeTime
   62:       ? {
   63:           day: "2-digit",
   64:           month: "short",
   65:           year: "numeric",
   66:           hour: "2-digit",

   68:         }
   69:       : {
   70:           day: "2-digit",
   71:           month: "long",
   72:           year: "numeric",
   73:         },
   74:   ).format(value);

   83: function formatStatus(status: StudentAssignmentStatus): string {
   84:   if (status === "in_progress") {
   85:     return "In Progress";
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   if (status === "completed") {
   89:     return "Completed";
   90:   }

   95: function escapeCsvValue(value: string): string {
   96:   return `"${value.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

   98: 
   99: function getDueDateInformation(dueDate: Date | null): {
  100:   label: string;
  101:   overdue: boolean;
  102: } {
  103:   if (!dueDate) {
  104:     return {
  105:       label: "No due date",
  106:       overdue: false,
  107:     };
  108:   }
  109: 
  110:   const today = new Date();
  111:   const due = new Date(dueDate);
  112: 
  113:   today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  114:   due.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  115: 
  116:   const differenceInDays = Math.ceil(
  117:     (due.getTime() - today.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24),
  118:   );
  119: 
  120:   if (differenceInDays < 0) {
  121:     const overdueDays = Math.abs(differenceInDays);
  122: 
  123:     return {
  124:       label: `${overdueDays} ${overdueDays === 1 ? "day" : "days"} overdue`,
  125:       overdue: true,
  126:     };
  127:   }
  128: 
  129:   if (differenceInDays === 0) {
  130:     return {
  131:       label: "Due today",
  132:       overdue: false,
  133:     };
  134:   }
  135: 
  136:   if (differenceInDays === 1) {
  137:     return {
  138:       label: "Due tomorrow",
  139:       overdue: false,
  140:     };
  141:   }
  142: 
  143:   return {
  144:     label: `${differenceInDays} days remaining`,
  145:     overdue: false,
  146:   };
  147: }

  568:                   type="search"
  569:                   value={searchTerm}
  570:                   onChange={handleSearchChange}
  571:                   placeholder="Search students..."
  572:                   className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 py-3 pl-11 pr-4 text-sm sm:w-72"
  573:                 />
  574:               </label>
  575: 
  576:               <select
  577:                 value={statusFilter}
  578:                 onChange={(event) =>
  579:                   setStatusFilter(event.target.value as StatusFilter)
  580:                 }
  581:                 className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold"
  582:               >
  583:                 <option value="all">All statuses</option>
  584:                 <option value="completed">Completed</option>
  585:                 <option value="in_progress">In progress</option>
  586:                 <option value="not_started">Not started</option>
  587:               </select>
  588:             </div>
  589:           </div>
  590:         </div>
  591: 
  592:         {rows.length === 0 ? (
  593:           <EmptyState
  594:             title="No students assigned"
  595:             description="No students are currently assigned to this resource."
  596:           />
  597:         ) : filteredRows.length === 0 ? (
  598:           <EmptyState
  599:             title="No matching students"
  600:             description="Try changing your search or status filter."
  601:           />
  602:         ) : (
  603:           <div className="overflow-x-auto">
  604:             <table className="min-w-full">
  605:               <thead className="bg-slate-50">
  606:                 <tr className="text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
  607:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Student</th>
  608:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Status</th>
  609:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Started</th>
  610:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Completed</th>
  611:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Last activity</th>
  612:                 </tr>
  613:               </thead>
  614: 
  615:               <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
  616:                 {filteredRows.map(({ student, progress }) => (
  617:                   <tr key={student.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
  618:                     <td className="px-6 py-5">
  619:                       <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
  620:                         <StudentAvatar name={student.name} />
  621: 
  622:                         <div>
  623:                           <p className="font-bold text-slate-950">
  624:                             {student.name}
  625:                           </p>
  626: 
  627:                           <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
  628:                             {student.email}
  629:                           </p>
  630:                         </div>
  631:                       </div>
  632:                     </td>
  633: 
  634:                     <td className="px-6 py-5">
  635:                       <StatusBadge status={progress.status} />
  636:                     </td>
  637: 
  638:                     <td className="px-6 py-5 text-sm text-slate-600">
  639:                       {formatDate(progress.startedAt, true)}
  640:                     </td>
  641: 
  642:                     <td className="px-6 py-5 text-sm text-slate-600">
  643:                       {formatDate(progress.completedAt, true)}
  644:                     </td>
  645: 
  646:                     <td className="px-6 py-5 text-sm text-slate-600">
  647:                       {formatDate(progress.updatedAt, true)}
  648:                     </td>
  649:                   </tr>
  650:                 ))}
  651:               </tbody>
  652:             </table>
  653:           </div>
  654:         )}
  655: 
  656:         {rows.length > 0 && (
  657:           <div className="border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-6 py-4 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-500">
  658:             Showing {filteredRows.length} of {rows.length} students
  659:           </div>
  660:         )}
  661:       </Card>
  662:     </div>
  663:   );
  664: }
  665: 
  666: function SummaryCard({
  667:   label,
  668:   value,
  669:   description,
  670:   icon,
  671:   iconClassName,
  672: }: {
  673:   label: string;
  674:   value: number;
  675:   description: string;
  676:   icon: ReactNode;
  677:   iconClassName: string;
  678: }) {
  679:   return (
  680:     <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6">
  681:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
  682:         <div>
  683:           <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500">{label}</p>
  684: 
  685:           <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black text-slate-950">{value}</p>
  686: 
  687:           <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">{description}</p>
  688:         </div>
  689: 
  690:         <div
  691:           className={`flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl ${iconClassName}`}
  692:         >
  693:           {icon}
  694:         </div>
  695:       </div>
  696:     </Card>
  697:   );
  698: }
  699: 
  700: function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: StudentAssignmentStatus }) {
  701:   if (status === "completed") {
  702:     return (
  703:       <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
  704:         <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
  705:         Completed
  706:       </span>
  707:     );
  708:   }
  709: 
  710:   if (status === "in_progress") {
  711:     return (
  712:       <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-700">
  713:         <Clock3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
  714:         In Progress
  715:       </span>
  716:     );
  717:   }
  718: 
  719:   return (
  720:     <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">
  721:       <XCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
  722:       Not Started
  723:     </span>
  724:   );
  725: }
  726: 
  727: function StudentAvatar({ name }: { name: string }) {
  728:   const initials = name
  729:     .split(" ")
  730:     .filter(Boolean)
  731:     .slice(0, 2)
  732:     .map((part) => part[0])
  733:     .join("")
  734:     .toUpperCase();
  735: 
  736:   return (
  737:     <div className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-teal-100 text-sm font-black text-teal-700">
  738:       {initials || "ST"}
  739:     </div>
  740:   );
  741: }
  742: 
  743: function EmptyState({
  744:   title,
  745:   description,
  746: }: {
  747:   title: string;
  748:   description: string;
  749: }) {
  750:   return (
  751:     <div className="p-10 text-center">
  752:       <Users className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-slate-400" />
  753: 
  754:       <h3 className="mt-4 text-xl font-black text-slate-950">{title}</h3>
  755: 
  756:       <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-lg text-sm text-slate-500">
  757:         {description}
  758:       </p>
  759:     </div>
  760:   );
  761: }

  988: function WizardProgress({
  989:   currentStep,
  990: }: {
  991:   currentStep: AssignmentWizardStep;
  992: }) {
  993:   const steps: Array<{
  994:     id: AssignmentWizardStep;
  995:     label: string;
  996:   }> = [
  997:     {
  998:       id: "resource",
  999:       label: "Resource",
 1000:     },
 1001:     {
 1002:       id: "classes",
 1003:       label: "Classes",
 1004:     },
 1005:     {
 1006:       id: "details",
 1007:       label: "Details",
 1008:     },
 1009:     {
 1010:       id: "review",
 1011:       label: "Review",
 1012:     },
 1013:   ];
 1014: 
 1015:   const currentIndex =
 1016:     steps.findIndex(
 1017:       (item) =>
 1018:         item.id === currentStep,
 1019:     );
 1020: 
 1021:   return (
 1022:     <Card>
 1023:       <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">
 1024:         {steps.map(
 1025:           (item, index) => {
 1026:             const complete =
 1027:               index < currentIndex;
 1028:             const active =
 1029:               item.id ===
 1030:               currentStep;
 1031: 
 1032:             return (
 1033:               <div
 1034:                 key={item.id}
 1035:                 className={`rounded-xl border p-4 text-center ${
 1036:                   active
 1037:                     ? "border-teal-500 bg-teal-50 text-teal-700"
 1038:                     : complete
 1039:                       ? "border-green-300 bg-green-50 text-green-700"
 1040:                       : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-500"
 1041:                 }`}
 1042:               >
 1043:                 <p className="text-sm font-bold">
 1044:                   {complete
 1045:                     ? "âœ“"
 1046:                     : index + 1}
 1047:                 </p>
 1048: 
 1049:                 <p className="mt-1 font-semibold">
 1050:                   {item.label}
 1051:                 </p>
 1052:               </div>
 1053:             );
 1054:           },
 1055:         )}
 1056:       </div>
 1057:     </Card>
 1058:   );
 1059: }
