   37: function defaultAcademicYear(): string {
   38:   const now = new Date();
   39: 
   40:   const year =
   41:     now.getFullYear();
   42: 
   43:   /*
   44:    * Treat August onward as preparation for the new UK academic year.
   45:    */
   46:   const startYear =
   47:     now.getMonth() >= 7
   48:       ? year
   49:       : year - 1;
   50: 
   51:   return `${startYear}/${startYear + 1}`;
   52: }

  825: function Metric({
  826:   label,
  827:   value,
  828: }: {

  842:   );

  845: function MiniMetric({
  846:   label,

  848: }: {

  851: }) {

  857:

  859:         {value}
  860:       </p>
  861:     </div>
  862:   );
  863: }
  864: 
  865: function Field({
  866:   label,

  888:           event,

  890:           onChange(
  891:             event.target.value,

  893:         }

  895:           placeholder

   41: function createBlueprintFromQuery({
   42:   topic,
   43:   difficulty,
   44:   questionCount,
   45:   totalMarks,
   46: }: {
   47:   topic: string;
   48:   difficulty: ExamQuestionDifficulty;
   49:   questionCount: number;
   50:   totalMarks: number;
   51: }): AssessmentBlueprintItem[] {
   52:   const balanced = createBalancedBlueprint(topic, difficulty);
   53: 
   54:   const safeCount = Math.min(20, Math.max(1, questionCount));
   55: 
   56:   const blueprint = Array.from(
   57:     {
   58:       length: safeCount,
   59:     },
   60:     (_, index) => ({
   61:       ...balanced[index % balanced.length],
   62:       id: `query-blueprint-${Date.now()}-${index}`,
   63:       questionNumber: index + 1,
   64:       topicFocus: topic,
   65:     }),
   66:   );
   67: 
   68:   if (totalMarks > 0) {
   69:     let remaining = Math.min(totalMarks, safeCount * 12);
   70: 
   71:     blueprint.forEach((item, index) => {
   72:       const questionsLeft = blueprint.length - index;
   73: 
   74:       const marks = Math.min(
   75:         12,
   76:         Math.max(1, Math.round(remaining / questionsLeft)),
   77:       );
   78: 
   79:       item.marks = marks;
   80:       remaining -= marks;
   81:     });
   82:   }
   83: 
   84:   return blueprint;
   85: }

   40: export default function TeacherQuizLibraryPage() {
   41:   const { user, loading: authLoading } = useAuth();
   42: 
   43:   const [quizzes, setQuizzes] = useState<SavedQuiz[]>([]);
   44:   const [loadingQuizzes, setLoadingQuizzes] = useState(true);
   45:   const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
   46: 
   47:   useEffect(() => {
   48:     if (authLoading) {
   49:       return;
   50:     }
   51: 
   52:     if (!user) {
   53:       setQuizzes([]);
   54:       setLoadingQuizzes(false);
   55:       return;
   56:     }
   57: 
   58:     const teacherId = user.uid;
   59: 
   60:     const quizzesQuery = query(
   61:       collection(db, "generatedQuizzes"),
   62:       where("teacherId", "==", teacherId),
   63:     );
   64: 
   65:     const unsubscribe = onSnapshot(
   66:       quizzesQuery,
   67:       (snapshot) => {
   68:         const loadedQuizzes: SavedQuiz[] = snapshot.docs.map((quizDocument) => {
   69:           const data = quizDocument.data();
   70: 
   71:           return {
   72:             id: quizDocument.id,
   73:             teacherId: data.teacherId || "",
   74:             title: data.title || "Untitled Quiz",
   75:             description: data.description || "",
   76:             topicId: data.topicId || "",
   77:             qualification: data.qualification || "GCSE",
   78:             examBoard: data.examBoard || "AQA",
   79:             difficulty:
   80:               data.difficulty === "foundation" || data.difficulty === "higher"
   81:                 ? data.difficulty
   82:                 : "standard",
   83:             estimatedTime: data.estimatedTime || "10 minutes",
   84:             questions: Array.isArray(data.questions) ? data.questions : [],
   85:             questionCount:
   86:               typeof data.questionCount === "number"
   87:                 ? data.questionCount
   88:                 : Array.isArray(data.questions)
   89:                   ? data.questions.length
   90:                   : 0,
   91:             status: data.status || "draft",
   92:             source: data.source || "ai",
   93:             createdAt: data.createdAt,
   94:           };
   95:         });
   96: 
   97:         loadedQuizzes.sort((a, b) => {

  452:   function updateDifferentiationItem(
  453:     field: DifferentiationField,
  454:     index: number,
  455:     value: string,
  456:   ) {
  457:     setResource((current) => {
  458:       if (!current) {
  459:         return current;
  460:       }
  461: 
  462:       const items = [...current.differentiation[field]];
  463: 
  464:       items[index] = value;
  465: 
  466:       return {
  467:         ...current,
  468:         differentiation: {
  469:           ...current.differentiation,
  470:           [field]: items,
  471:         },
  472:       };
  473:     });
  474:   }
  475: 
  476:   function addDifferentiationItem(field: DifferentiationField) {
  477:     setResource((current) => {
  478:       if (!current) {
  479:         return current;
  480:       }
  481: 
  482:       return {
  483:         ...current,
  484:         differentiation: {
  485:           ...current.differentiation,
  486:           [field]: [...current.differentiation[field], ""],
  487:         },
  488:       };
  489:     });
  490:   }
  491: 
  492:   function removeDifferentiationItem(
  493:     field: DifferentiationField,
  494:     index: number,
  495:   ) {
  496:     setResource((current) => {
  497:       if (!current || current.differentiation[field].length <= 1) {
  498:         return current;
  499:       }
  500: 
  501:       return {
  502:         ...current,
  503:         differentiation: {
  504:           ...current.differentiation,
  505:           [field]: current.differentiation[field].filter(
  506:             (_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index,
  507:           ),
  508:         },
  509:       };
  510:     });
  511:   }
  512: 
  513:   function updateMisconception(
  514:     index: number,
  515:     field: keyof ResourceMisconception,
  516:     value: string,
  517:   ) {
  518:     setResource((current) => {
  519:       if (!current) {
  520:         return current;
  521:       }
  522: 
  523:       const misconceptions = [...current.misconceptions];
  524: 
  525:       misconceptions[index] = {
  526:         ...misconceptions[index],
  527:         [field]: value,
  528:       };
  529: 
  530:       return {
  531:         ...current,
  532:         misconceptions,
  533:       };
  534:     });
  535:   }
  536: 
  537:   function addMisconception() {
  538:     setResource((current) => {
  539:       if (!current) {
  540:         return current;
  541:       }
  542: 
  543:       return {
  544:         ...current,
  545:         misconceptions: [...current.misconceptions, createEmptyMisconception()],
  546:       };
  547:     });
  548:   }
  549: 
  550:   function removeMisconception(index: number) {
  551:     setResource((current) => {
  552:       if (!current) {
  553:         return current;
  554:       }
  555: 
  556:       return {
  557:         ...current,
  558:         misconceptions: current.misconceptions.filter(
  559:           (_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index,
  560:         ),
  561:       };
  562:     });
  563:   }
  564: 
  565:   function updateAssessmentQuestion(
  566:     index: number,
  567:     field: keyof ResourceAssessmentQuestion,
  568:     value: string | number,
  569:   ) {
  570:     setResource((current) => {
  571:       if (!current) {
  572:         return current;
  573:       }
  574: 
  575:       const assessmentQuestions = [...current.assessmentQuestions];
  576: 
  577:       assessmentQuestions[index] = {
  578:         ...assessmentQuestions[index],
  579:         [field]: value,
  580:       };
  581: 
  582:       return {
  583:         ...current,
  584:         assessmentQuestions,
  585:       };
  586:     });
  587:   }
  588: 
  589:   function addAssessmentQuestion() {
  590:     setResource((current) => {
  591:       if (!current) {
  592:         return current;
  593:       }
  594: 
  595:       return {
  596:         ...current,
  597:         assessmentQuestions: [
  598:           ...current.assessmentQuestions,
  599:           createEmptyAssessmentQuestion(),
  600:         ],
  601:       };
  602:     });
  603:   }
  604: 
  605:   function removeAssessmentQuestion(index: number) {
  606:     setResource((current) => {
  607:       if (!current || current.assessmentQuestions.length <= 1) {
  608:         return current;
  609:       }
  610: 
  611:       return {
  612:         ...current,
  613:         assessmentQuestions: current.assessmentQuestions.filter(
  614:           (_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index,
  615:         ),
  616:       };
  617:     });
  618:   }
  619: 
  620:   function validateResource(): string | null {
  621:     if (!resource) {
  622:       return "The resource could not be loaded.";
  623:     }
  624: 
  625:     if (resource.title.trim().length < 2) {
  626:       return "Enter a valid resource title.";
  627:     }
  628: 
  629:     if (resource.topic.trim().length < 2) {
  630:       return "Enter a valid topic.";
  631:     }
  632: 
  633:     if (!resource.overview.trim()) {
  634:       return "Enter a resource overview.";
  635:     }
  636: 
  637:     if (resource.learningObjectives.some((item) => !item.trim())) {
  638:       return "Learning objectives cannot contain blank items.";
  639:     }
  640: 
  641:     if (resource.successCriteria.some((item) => !item.trim())) {
  642:       return "Success criteria cannot contain blank items.";
  643:     }
  644: 
  645:     if (
  646:       resource.sections.some(
  647:         (section) =>
  648:           !section.title.trim() ||
  649:           !section.teacherInstructions.trim() ||
  650:           !section.studentTask.trim(),
  651:       )
  652:     ) {
  653:       return "Every section requires a title, teacher instructions and student task.";
  654:     }
  655: 
  656:     if (
  657:       resource.assessmentQuestions.some(
  658:         (question) =>
  659:           !question.question.trim() ||
  660:           !question.answer.trim() ||
  661:           question.marks < 1,
  662:       )
  663:     ) {
  664:       return "Every assessment question requires a question, answer and valid mark value.";
  665:     }
  666: 
  667:     return null;
  668:   }
  669: 
  670:   async function handleSave() {
  671:     const validationError = validateResource();
  672: 
  673:     if (validationError) {
  674:       setError(validationError);
  675:       setSuccess(null);
  676:       return;
  677:     }
  678: 
  679:     if (!resource) {
  680:       return;
  681:     }
  682: 
  683:     setSaving(true);
  684:     setError(null);
  685:     setSuccess(null);
  686: 
  687:     try {
  688:       const cleanedResource: GeneratedTeachingResource = {
  689:         ...resource,
  690:         title: resource.title.trim(),
  691:         topic: resource.topic.trim(),
  692:         overview: resource.overview.trim(),
  693:         learningObjectives: resource.learningObjectives.map((item) =>
  694:           item.trim(),
  695:         ),
  696:         successCriteria: resource.successCriteria.map((item) => item.trim()),
  697:         keywords: resource.keywords.map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean),
  698:         priorKnowledge: resource.priorKnowledge
  699:           .map((item) => item.trim())
  700:           .filter(Boolean),
  701:         sections: resource.sections.map((section) => ({
  702:           ...section,
  703:           title: section.title.trim(),
  704:           duration: section.duration.trim(),
  705:           teacherInstructions: section.teacherInstructions.trim(),
  706:           studentTask: section.studentTask.trim(),
  707:           assessment: section.assessment.trim(),
  708:           resources: section.resources
  709:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  710:             .filter(Boolean),
  711:         })),
  712:         differentiation: {
  713:           support: resource.differentiation.support
  714:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  715:             .filter(Boolean),
  716:           core: resource.differentiation.core
  717:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  718:             .filter(Boolean),
  719:           stretch: resource.differentiation.stretch
  720:             .map((item) => item.trim())
  721:             .filter(Boolean),
  722:         },
  723:         misconceptions: resource.misconceptions
  724:           .map((item) => ({
  725:             misconception: item.misconception.trim(),
  726:             correction: item.correction.trim(),
  727:           }))
  728:           .filter((item) => item.misconception && item.correction),
  729:         assessmentQuestions: resource.assessmentQuestions.map((question) => ({
  730:           question: question.question.trim(),
  731:           answer: question.answer.trim(),
  732:           marks: Math.max(1, Math.round(question.marks)),
  733:         })),
  734:         homework: resource.homework.trim(),
  735:         teacherNotes: resource.teacherNotes.trim(),
  736:       };
  737: 
  738:       await updateTeacherResourceContent(resourceId, cleanedResource);
  739: 
  740:       setResource(cleanedResource);
  741:       setSuccess("Your resource changes were saved successfully.");
  742: 
  743:       window.setTimeout(() => {
  744:         router.push(`/teacher/resources/${resourceId}`);
  745:       }, 800);
  746:     } catch (caughtError) {
  747:       console.error("Failed to save resource changes:", caughtError);
  748: 
  749:       setError(
  750:         caughtError instanceof Error
  751:           ? caughtError.message
  752:           : "Your changes could not be saved.",
  753:       );
  754:     } finally {
  755:       setSaving(false);
  756:     }
  757:   }
  758: 
  759:   if (authLoading || loading) {
  760:     return <EditPageSkeleton />;
  761:   }
  762: 
  763:   if (error && !resource) {
  764:     return (
  765:       <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl px-4 py-10 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
  766:         <Link
  767:           href="/teacher/resources"
  768:           className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700"
  769:         >
  770:           <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
  771:           Back to Resource Library
  772:         </Link>
  773: 
  774:         <section className="mt-8 rounded-3xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-8 text-center">
  775:           <AlertCircle className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-red-600" />
  776: 
  777:           <h1 className="mt-4 text-2xl font-bold text-red-950">
  778:             Resource unavailable
  779:           </h1>
  780: 
  781:           <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-800">{error}</p>
  782:         </section>
  783:       </main>
  784:     );
  785:   }
  786: 
  787:   if (!resource) {
  788:     return null;
  789:   }
  790: 
  791:   return (
  792:     <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-7xl space-y-6 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
  793:       <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
  794:         <Link
  795:           href={`/teacher/resources/${resourceId}`}
  796:           className="inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-700"
  797:         >
  798:           <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
  799:           Cancel editing
  800:         </Link>
  801: 
  802:         <button
  803:           type="button"
  804:           onClick={handleSave}
  805:           disabled={saving}
  806:           className="inline-flex w-fit items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-100 transition hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300 disabled:shadow-none"
  807:         >
  808:           {saving ? (
  809:             <>
  810:               <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
  811:               Saving changes...
  812:             </>
  813:           ) : (
  814:             <>
  815:               <Save className="h-5 w-5" />
  816:               Save changes
  817:             </>
  818:           )}
  819:         </button>
  820:       </div>
  821: 
  822:       <section className="rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-700 via-indigo-600 to-sky-600 p-6 text-white shadow-lg sm:p-8">
  823:         <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
  824:           <div className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-white/15">
  825:             <BookOpen className="h-6 w-6" />
  826:           </div>
  827: 
  828:           <div>
  829:             <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight">
  830:               Edit teaching resource
  831:             </h1>
  832: 
  833:             <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl leading-7 text-indigo-50">
  834:               Refine the generated lesson content before publishing, exporting
  835:               or assigning it to a class.
  836:             </p>
  837:           </div>
  838:         </div>
  839:       </section>
  840: 
  841:       {error && (
  842:         <div
  843:           role="alert"
  844:           className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800"
  845:         >
  846:           <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  847: 
  848:           <div>
  849:             <p className="font-bold">Changes not saved</p>
  850: 
  851:             <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6">{error}</p>
  852:           </div>
  853:         </div>
  854:       )}
  855: 
  856:       {success && (
  857:         <div
  858:           role="status"
  859:           className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-emerald-800"
  860:         >
  861:           <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  862: 
  863:           <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{success}</p>
  864:         </div>
  865:       )}
  866: 
  867:       <section className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm sm:p-6">
  868:         <SectionHeader
  869:           icon={<BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" />}

  872:         />
  873:

  877:               Resource title
  878:             </FieldLabel>
  879: 
  880:             <input

  883:               onChange={(event) =>
  884:                 updateTopLevelField("title", event.target.value)
  885:               }
  886:               maxLength={200}
  887:               className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm text-slate-900 outline-none transition focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"

  904:             />

   21: function formatDate(value: Date | null, includeTime = false): string {
   22:   if (!value) {
   23:     return "â€”";
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
   27:     "en-GB",
   28:     includeTime

   32:           year: "numeric",

   35:         }
   36:       : {
   37:           day: "2-digit",
   38:           month: "short",
   39:           year: "numeric",

   42: }
   43: 
   44: function formatDuration(seconds: number): string {
   45:   if (seconds <= 0) {
   46:     return "No data";
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
   50: 
   51:   const remainingSeconds = seconds % 60;
   52: 
   53:   if (minutes === 0) {
   54:     return `${remainingSeconds}s`;
   55:   }
   56: 
   57:   return `${minutes}m ${remainingSeconds}s`;
   58: }
   59: 
   60: function formatQualification(value: string): string {
   61:   if (!value.trim()) {
   62:     return "Not selected";
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   return value
   66:     .replace(/[-_]/g, " ")
   67:     .replace(/\b\w/g, (character) => character.toUpperCase());

   70: function getInitials(name: string): string {
   71:   return (

  137: 
  138:   const sortedOutstanding = useMemo(
  139:     () =>
  140:       analytics
  141:         ? [...analytics.outstandingActivities].sort((first, second) => {
  142:             const firstOverdue = first.status === "overdue";
  143: 
  144:             const secondOverdue = second.status === "overdue";
  145: 
  146:             if (firstOverdue !== secondOverdue) {
  147:               return firstOverdue ? -1 : 1;
  148:             }
  149: 
  150:             return (
  151:               (first.dueDate?.getTime() || Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) -
  152:               (second.dueDate?.getTime() || Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
  153:             );
  154:           })
  155:         : [],
  156:     [analytics],
  157:   );
  158: 
  159:   if (loading) {
  160:     return (
  161:       <div className="space-y-8">
  162:         <Skeleton className="h-64 w-full rounded-3xl" />
  163: 
  164:         <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
  165:           {Array.from({
  166:             length: 8,
  167:           }).map((_, index) => (
  168:             <Skeleton key={index} className="h-28 rounded-3xl" />
  169:           ))}
  170:         </div>
  171: 
  172:         <Skeleton className="h-96 w-full rounded-3xl" />
  173:       </div>
  174:     );
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   if (!analytics || error) {
  178:     return (
  179:       <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-8 text-center">
  180:         <AlertCircle className="mx-auto h-10 w-10 text-red-600" />
  181: 
  182:         <h1 className="mt-5 text-2xl font-black text-red-950">
  183:           Student analytics unavailable
  184:         </h1>
  185: 
  186:         <p className="mx-auto mt-3 max-w-xl text-sm text-red-800">
  187:           {error || "The student analytics could not be loaded."}
  188:         </p>
  189: 
  190:         <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:flex-row">
  191:           <button
  192:             type="button"
  193:             onClick={() => {
  194:               void loadAnalytics();
  195:             }}
  196:             className="rounded-xl bg-red-600 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white"
  197:           >
  198:             Try again
  199:           </button>
  200: 
  201:           <Link
  202:             href="/teacher/students"
  203:             className="rounded-xl border border-red-300 bg-white px-5 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-red-700"
  204:           >
  205:             Back to students
  206:           </Link>
  207:         </div>
  208:       </Card>
  209:     );
  210:   }
  211: 
  212:   const { student, classes, metrics } = analytics;
  213: 
  214:   return (
  215:     <div className="space-y-8">
  216:       <section className="rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-700 via-teal-700 to-cyan-700 p-7 text-white shadow-xl sm:p-9">
  217:         <Link
  218:           href="/teacher/students"
  219:           className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-emerald-100 hover:text-white"
  220:         >
  221:           <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
  222:           All students
  223:         </Link>
  224: 
  225:         <div className="mt-7 flex flex-col gap-7 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
  226:           <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
  227:             <div className="flex h-20 w-20 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-3xl bg-white/15 text-2xl font-black">
  228:               {getInitials(student.name)}
  229:             </div>
  230: 
  231:             <div>
  232:               <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-emerald-100">
  233:                 Student analytics
  234:               </p>
  235: 
  236:               <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black sm:text-4xl">
  237:                 {student.name}
  238:               </h1>
  239: 
  240:               <p className="mt-2 text-emerald-100">
  241:                 {student.email || "No email available"}
  242:               </p>
  243: 
  244:               <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  245:                 {classes.map((studentClass) => (
  246:                   <span
  247:                     key={studentClass.id}
  248:                     className="rounded-full bg-white/15 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold"
  249:                   >
  250:                     {studentClass.name}
  251:                   </span>
  252:                 ))}
  253: 
  254:                 {classes.length === 0 && (
  255:                   <span className="rounded-full bg-white/15 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold">
  256:                     No teacher class
  257:                   </span>
  258:                 )}
  259:               </div>
  260:             </div>
  261:           </div>
  262: 
  263:           <div className="grid min-w-72 grid-cols-2 gap-3 rounded-3xl border border-white/20 bg-white/10 p-5">
  264:             <HeroMetric label="Current grade" value={metrics.currentGrade} />
  265: 
  266:             <HeroMetric
  267:               label="Predicted grade"
  268:               value={metrics.predictedGrade}
  269:             />
  270: 
  271:             <HeroMetric
  272:               label="Completion"
  273:               value={`${metrics.completionRate}%`}
  274:             />
  275: 
  276:             <HeroMetric
  277:               label="Assessment average"
  278:               value={`${metrics.combinedAssessmentAverage}%`}
  279:             />
  280:           </div>

  282:       </section>
  283: 
  284:       <section className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">

  298:           iconClassName="bg-amber-50 text-amber-600"
  299:         />
  300:

  323:         />
  324:

  328:           description={

  330:               ? `Best ${metrics.highestExamScore}%`

  332:           }

  335:         />
  336:

  338:           label="XP"

  340:           description={`${metrics.assignmentXP} earned from assignments`}
  341:           icon={<Star className="h-6 w-6" />}
  342:           iconClassName="bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-600"
  343:         />
  344:

  348:           description="Current learning streak"
  349:           icon={<Flame className="h-6 w-6" />}
  350:           iconClassName="bg-orange-50 text-orange-600"
  351:         />
  352: 
  353:         <SummaryCard
  354:           label="Lessons"
  355:           value={metrics.completedLessons}
  356:           description={`${metrics.completedTopics} topics completed`}
  357:           icon={<BookOpen className="h-6 w-6" />}
  358:           iconClassName="bg-teal-50 text-teal-600"
  359:         />
  360:

  363:           value={
  364:             metrics.improvementTrend > 0
  365:               ? `+${metrics.improvementTrend}%`
  366:               : `${metrics.improvementTrend}%`
  367:           }
  368:           description={
  369:             metrics.improvementTrend >= 0
  370:               ? "Recent improvement"
  371:               : "Recent decline"

  412:           />

  415:             {analytics.recommendations.map((recommendation) => (
  416:               <RecommendationCard

  418:                 recommendation={recommendation}
  419:               />
  420:             ))}
  421:           </div>
  422:         </Card>
  423:       </section>
  424: 
  425:       <section className="grid gap-6 xl:grid-cols-2">
  426:         <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6">
  427:           <SectionHeading
  428:             eyebrow="Strengths"
  429:             title="Secure areas"
  430:             description="Topics currently assessed at 70% or higher."
  431:           />
  432: 
  433:           {analytics.strongestTopics.length === 0 ? (
  434:             <EmptyMessage message="No secure assessed topics have been identified yet." />
  435:           ) : (
  436:             <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
  437:               {analytics.strongestTopics.map((topic) => (
  438:                 <TopicHighlight key={topic.id} topic={topic} positive />
  439:               ))}
  440:             </div>
  441:           )}
  442:         </Card>
  443: 
  444:         <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6">
  445:           <SectionHeading
  446:             eyebrow="Support"
  447:             title="Priority areas"
  448:             description="Topics currently assessed below 50%."
  449:           />
  450: 
  451:           {analytics.weakestTopics.length === 0 ? (
  452:             <EmptyMessage message="No priority assessed topics are currently identified." />
  453:           ) : (
  454:             <div className="mt-6 space-y-3">
  455:               {analytics.weakestTopics.map((topic) => (
  456:                 <TopicHighlight key={topic.id} topic={topic} positive={false} />
  457:               ))}
  458:             </div>
  459:           )}
  460:         </Card>
  461:       </section>
  462: 
  463:       <Card className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-0">
  464:         <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-6 sm:p-7">
  465:           <SectionHeading
  466:             eyebrow="Learning history"
  467:             title="Recent activity"
  468:             description="The studentâ€™s most recent completed learning activities."
  469:           />
  470:         </div>
  471: 
  472:         {analytics.recentActivities.length === 0 ? (
  473:           <EmptyMessage message="No completed activity has been recorded yet." />
  474:         ) : (
  475:           <div className="overflow-x-auto">
  476:             <table className="min-w-full">
  477:               <thead className="bg-slate-50">
  478:                 <tr className="text-left text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500">
  479:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Activity</th>
  480: 
  481:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Type</th>
  482: 
  483:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Score</th>
  484: 
  485:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">XP</th>
  486: 
  487:                   <th className="px-6 py-4">Time</th>
  488:

  490:                 </tr>

  492:

  497:               </tbody>
  498:             </table>

  508:         />
  509:

  512:         ) : (

  527:           />
  528:

  533:             />

  549:                 "No classes"
  550:               }
  551:             />
  552: 
  553:             <DetailRow
  554:               label="Average Quiz Time"
  555:               value={formatDuration(metrics.averageTimeTakenSeconds)}
  556:             />
  557:           </div>
  558:         </Card>
  559: <StudentIntelligenceRecord studentId={studentId} />
  560:         <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6">
  561:           <SectionHeading
  562:             eyebrow="Progress"
  563:             title="Learning totals"
  564:             description="Recorded curriculum and assignment progress."
  565:           />
  566: 
  567:           <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">

  662: function SectionHeading({
  663:   eyebrow,

  684: function TopicRow({ topic }: { topic: StudentTopicPerformance }) {
  685:   const barClassName =
  686:     topic.classification === "strength"
  687:       ? "bg-emerald-500"
  688:       : topic.classification === "support"
  689:         ? "bg-red-500"
  690:         : "bg-amber-500";
  691: 
  692:   return (
  693:     <div className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-4">
  694:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
  695:         <div>
  696:           <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">{topic.topic}</p>
  697: 
  698:           <p className="mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
  699:             {topic.attempts} attempt
  700:             {topic.attempts === 1 ? "" : "s"}
  701:           </p>
  702:         </div>
  703: 
  704:         <p className="font-black text-slate-900">{topic.averageScore}%</p>
  705:       </div>
  706: 
  707:       <div className="mt-3 h-2.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-200">
  708:         <div
  709:           className={`h-full rounded-full ${barClassName}`}
  710:           style={{
  711:             width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, topic.averageScore))}%`,
  712:           }}
  713:         />
  714:       </div>
  715:     </div>
  716:   );
  717: }

  732:       }`}
  733:     >
  734:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
  735:         <p className="font-bold text-slate-900">{topic.topic}</p>
  736: 
  737:         <p
  738:           className={`font-black ${
  739:             positive ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-red-700"
  740:           }`}
  741:         >
  742:           {topic.averageScore}%
  743:         </p>
  744:       </div>
  745:     </div>

  749: function RecommendationCard({
  750:   recommendation,
  751: }: {
  752:   recommendation: StudentAnalyticsRecommendation;
  753: }) {
  754:   const classes =
  755:     recommendation.priority === "high"
  756:       ? "border-red-200 bg-red-50"
  757:       : recommendation.priority === "medium"
  758:         ? "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50"
  759:         : "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50";
  760: 
  761:   return (
  762:     <div className={`rounded-2xl border p-5 ${classes}`}>
  763:       <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
  764:         {recommendation.priority === "positive" ? (

    1: import type { AdaptiveTopicMastery } from "@/types/adaptiveLearning";
    2: 
    3: export default function ReviewSchedule({
    4:   topics,
    5: }: {
    6:   topics: AdaptiveTopicMastery[];
    7: }) {
    8:   const upcoming = [...topics]
    9:     .sort(
   10:       (first, second) =>
   11:         first.nextReviewAt.getTime() - second.nextReviewAt.getTime(),
   12:     )
   13:     .slice(0, 6);
   14: 
   15:   return (
   16:     <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6">
   17:       <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-teal-600">
   18:         Spaced retrieval
   19:       </p>
   20:       <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">
   21:         Review schedule
   22:       </h2>
   23: 
   24:       <div className="mt-5 space-y-3">
   25:         {upcoming.map((topic) => {
   26:           const due = topic.nextReviewAt.getTime() <= Date.now();
   27: 
   28:           return (
   29:             <div
   30:               key={topic.id}
   31:               className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-4"
   32:             >
   33:               <div>
   34:                 <p className="font-black text-slate-900">{topic.topic}</p>
   35:                 <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
   36:                   Every {topic.reviewIntervalDays} day
   37:                   {topic.reviewIntervalDays === 1 ? "" : "s"}
   38:                 </p>
   39:               </div>
   40: 
   41:               <span
   42:                 className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${
   43:                   due ? "bg-red-100 text-red-700" : "bg-teal-100 text-teal-700"
   44:                 }`}
   45:               >
   46:                 {due
   47:                   ? "Due now"
   48:                   : topic.nextReviewAt.toLocaleDateString("en-GB")}
   49:               </span>
   50:             </div>
   51:           );
   52:         })}
   53:       </div>
   54:     </div>
   55:   );

    1: "use client";
    2:

    4: 
    5: import ReadAloudButton from "@/components/audio/ReadAloudButton";
    6: import type { PracticeQuestion } from "@/types/curriculum";
    7: import type { PracticeResponse } from "@/types/interactiveLesson";
    8: 
    9: type Props = {
   10:   questions: PracticeQuestion[];
   11:   initialResponses: PracticeResponse[];
   12:   onChange: (responses: PracticeResponse[]) => void;
   13: };
   14: 
   15: function normaliseAnswer(value: string): string {
   16:   return value
   17:     .trim()
   18:     .toLowerCase()
   19:     .replace(/[.,!?]/g, "")
   20:     .replace(/[-_]/g, " ")
   21:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
   22: }
   23: 
   24: function isAcceptedAnswer(
   25:   response: string,
   26:   question: PracticeQuestion,
   27: ): boolean {
   28:   const normalisedResponse = normaliseAnswer(response);
   29: 
   30:   const acceptedAnswers = [
   31:     question.answer,
   32:     ...(question.acceptedAnswers ?? []),
   33:   ].map(normaliseAnswer);
   34: 
   35:   return acceptedAnswers.includes(normalisedResponse);
   36: }
   37: 
   38: function createInitialResponses(
   39:   questions: PracticeQuestion[],
   40:   existingResponses: PracticeResponse[],
   41: ): PracticeResponse[] {
   42:   return questions.map((_, index) => {
   43:     const existingResponse = existingResponses.find(
   44:       (response) => response.questionIndex === index,
   45:     );
   46: 
   47:     return (
   48:       existingResponse ?? {
   49:         questionIndex: index,
   50:         response: "",
   51:         correct: false,
   52:         checked: false,
   53:       }
   54:     );
   55:   });
   56: }
   57: 
   58: export default function LessonPracticeStep({
   59:   questions,
   60:   initialResponses,
   61:   onChange,
   62: }: Props) {
   63:   const [responses, setResponses] = useState<PracticeResponse[]>(() =>
   64:     createInitialResponses(questions, initialResponses),
   65:   );
   66: 
   67:   useEffect(() => {
   68:     setResponses(createInitialResponses(questions, initialResponses));
   69:   }, [questions, initialResponses]);
   70: 
   71:   function updateResponse(
   72:     questionIndex: number,
   73:     updates: Partial<PracticeResponse>,
   74:   ) {
   75:     const updatedResponses = responses.map((response) =>
   76:       response.questionIndex === questionIndex
   77:         ? {
   78:             ...response,
   79:             ...updates,
   80:           }
   81:         : response,
   82:     );
   83: 
   84:     setResponses(updatedResponses);
   85:     onChange(updatedResponses);
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   function checkAnswer(questionIndex: number) {
   89:     const question = questions[questionIndex];
   90: 
   91:     const response = responses.find(
   92:       (item) => item.questionIndex === questionIndex,
   93:     );
   94: 
   95:     if (!question || !response) {
   96:       return;
   97:     }
   98: 
   99:     updateResponse(questionIndex, {
  100:       checked: true,
  101:       correct: isAcceptedAnswer(response.response, question),
  102:     });
  103:   }
  104: 
  105:   if (questions.length === 0) {
  106:     return (
  107:       <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6">
  108:         <p className="italic text-slate-500">
  109:           No guided-practice questions are required for this lesson.
  110:         </p>
  111:       </div>
  112:     );
  113:   }
  114: 
  115:   return (
  116:     <div className="space-y-5">
  117:       {questions.map((question, index) => {
  118:         const response = responses.find(
  119:           (item) => item.questionIndex === index,
  120:         ) ?? {
  121:           questionIndex: index,
  122:           response: "",
  123:           correct: false,
  124:           checked: false,
  125:         };
  126: 
  127:         return (
  128:           <article
  129:             key={`${question.question}-${index}`}
  130:             className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm"
  131:           >
  132:             <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between">
  133:               <div>
  134:                 <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-blue-600">
  135:                   Question {index + 1}
  136:                 </p>
  137: 
  138:                 <h3 className="mt-2 text-lg font-black text-slate-950">
  139:                   {question.question}
  140:                 </h3>
  141:               </div>
  142: 
  143:               <ReadAloudButton text={question.question} label="Read question" />
  144:             </div>
  145: 
  146:             {question.hint && (
  147:               <details className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4">
  148:                 <summary className="cursor-pointer font-bold text-amber-900">
  149:                   Show hint
  150:                 </summary>
  151: 
  152:                 <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-amber-800">{question.hint}</p>
  153:               </details>
  154:             )}
  155: 
  156:             <input
  157:               type="text"
  158:               value={response.response}
  159:               onChange={(event) =>
  160:                 updateResponse(index, {
  161:                   response: event.target.value,
  162:                   checked: false,
  163:                   correct: false,
  164:                 })
  165:               }
  166:               placeholder="Type your answer..."
  167:               className="mt-5 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 outline-none transition focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100"
  168:             />
  169: 
  170:             <button
  171:               type="button"
  172:               onClick={() => checkAnswer(index)}
  173:               disabled={!response.response.trim()}
  174:               className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 py-3 font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300"
  175:             >
  176:               Check answer
  177:             </button>
  178: 
  179:             {response.checked && (
  180:               <div
  181:                 className={`mt-5 rounded-2xl border p-4 ${

  185:                 }`}

  187:                 <p className="font-black">
  188:                   {response.correct ? "âœ… Correct" : "âŒ Not quite"}

  286: 
  287:       setStdin(
  288:         challenge.stdin ??
  289:           challenge.visibleTests[0]
  290:             ?.input ??
  291:           "",
  292:       );
  293: 
  294:       if (
  295:         challenge.id !==
  296:         currentChallengeId
  297:       ) {
  298:         setCurrentChallengeId(
  299:           challenge.id,
  300:         );
  301:       }
  302:     }
  303: 
  304:     setRunResult(emptyRun);
  305:     setEvaluation(null);
  306:     setHintLevel(0);
  307:     setShowExplanation(false);
  308:   }, [
  309:     assignedMode,
  310:     challenge,
  311:     currentChallengeId,
  312:     mode,
  313:   ]);

  315:   async function handleRun() {
  316:     if (!code.trim()) return;
  317: 
  318:     setRunning(true);
  319:     setRunResult(emptyRun);
  320: 
  321:     setStatusMessage(
  322:       "Running Python in the browser...",
  323:     );
  324: 
  325:     try {
  326:       const result =
  327:         await runPython({
  328:           code,
  329:           stdin,
  330:           timeoutMs: 3000,
  331:         });
  332: 
  333:       setRunResult(result);
  334: 
  335:       if (result.timedOut) {
  336:         setStatusMessage(
  337:           "Execution stopped because it exceeded the time limit.",
  338:         );
  339:       } else if (
  340:         result.error ||
  341:         result.stderr
  342:       ) {
  343:         setStatusMessage(
  344:           "Python returned an error. Use the console to debug it.",
  345:         );
  346:       } else {
  347:         setStatusMessage(
  348:           "Run complete.",
  349:         );
  350:       }
  351:     } catch (error) {
  352:       setRunResult({
  353:         ...emptyRun,
  354:         error:
  355:           error instanceof Error
  356:             ? error.message
  357:             : "Python could not run.",
  358:       });
  359: 
  360:       setStatusMessage(
  361:         "The Python runtime could not start.",
  362:       );
  363:     } finally {
  364:       setRunning(false);
  365:     }
  366:   }

  388:           code,

  393:       const awarded =

  395:           challenge,
  396:           result.passed,

  399:       if (

  401:         assignmentId &&

  455:         error instanceof Error
  456:           ? error.message
  457:           : "The solution could not be checked.",
  458:       );

  460:       setChecking(false);
  461:     }
  462:   }

   35: const DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS = 8 * 60;
   36: const FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS = 5;
   37: 
   38: function parseQuizDurationSeconds(value: string): number {
   39:   const normalised = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   40: 
   41:   if (!normalised) {
   42:     return DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS;
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   const hoursMatch = normalised.match(
   46:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:hours?|hrs?|hr|h)\b/,
   47:   );
   48: 
   49:   const minutesMatch = normalised.match(
   50:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:minutes?|mins?|min|m)\b/,
   51:   );
   52: 
   53:   const secondsMatch = normalised.match(
   54:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:seconds?|secs?|sec|s)\b/,
   55:   );
   56: 
   57:   const hours = hoursMatch ? Number(hoursMatch[1]) : 0;
   58:   const minutes = minutesMatch ? Number(minutesMatch[1]) : 0;
   59:   const seconds = secondsMatch ? Number(secondsMatch[1]) : 0;
   60: 
   61:   const totalSeconds = Math.round(
   62:     hours * 60 * 60 +
   63:       minutes * 60 +
   64:       seconds,
   65:   );
   66: 
   67:   return totalSeconds > 0
   68:     ? totalSeconds
   69:     : DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS;
   70: }
   71: 
   72: function getGrade(scorePercent: number) {
   73:   if (scorePercent >= 90) return "Grade 9";
   74:   if (scorePercent >= 80) return "Grade 8";
   75:   if (scorePercent >= 70) return "Grade 7";
   76:   if (scorePercent >= 60) return "Grade 6";
   77:   if (scorePercent >= 50) return "Grade 5";
   78:   if (scorePercent >= 40) return "Grade 4";
   79:   if (scorePercent >= 30) return "Grade 3";
   80:   if (scorePercent >= 20) return "Grade 2";
   81:   return "Grade 1";
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function getMessage(scorePercent: number) {
   85:   if (scorePercent >= 90) return "Outstanding performance!";
   86:   if (scorePercent >= 75) return "Excellent work!";
   87:   if (scorePercent >= 60) return "Good progress!";
   88:   if (scorePercent >= 40) return "You are getting there.";
   89:   return "Keep practising. You can improve this.";
   90: }
   91: 
   92: function createIncident(
   93:   type: QuizIntegrityIncident["type"],
   94:   questionNumber: number | null,
   95:   detail: string,
   96: ): QuizIntegrityIncident {
   97:   return {
   98:     id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`,
   99:     type,
  100:     occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  101:     questionNumber,
  102:     detail,
  103:   };
  104: }

  106: export default function QuizPlayer({ quiz }: Props) {
  107:   const { user } = useAuth();

  111: 
  112:   const quizDurationSeconds = useMemo(
  113:     () => parseQuizDurationSeconds(quiz.estimatedTime),
  114:     [quiz.estimatedTime],
  115:   );
  116: 
  117:   const assessmentRootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  119:   const assignmentSaveInProgress = useRef(false);
  120:   const finishingRef = useRef(false);
  121: 
  122:   /*
  123:    * Synchronous integrity termination flag.
  124:    *
  125:    * React state updates are asynchronous. This ref makes the zero-XP rule

  127:    */
  128:   const integrityTerminatedRef = useRef(false);
  129: 
  130:   const fullscreenExitActiveRef = useRef(false);

  132:   const integrityIncidentsRef = useRef<QuizIntegrityIncident[]>([]);
  133: 
  134:   const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);

  137:   const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(() => quizDurationSeconds);
  138:   const [resultSaved, setResultSaved] = useState(false);
  139:   const [assignmentResultSaved, setAssignmentResultSaved] = useState(false);
  140: 
  141:   const [linkedAssignment, setLinkedAssignment] =
  142:     useState<LinkedAssignment | null>(null);
  143:   const [assignmentLoading, setAssignmentLoading] = useState(Boolean(assignmentId));
  144:   const [assignmentError, setAssignmentError] = useState("");
  145: 
  146:   const [integrityStarted, setIntegrityStarted] = useState(false);
  147:   const [integritySessionStartedAt, setIntegritySessionStartedAt] =
  148:     useState<string | null>(null);
  149:   const [fullscreenCountdown, setFullscreenCountdown] =
  150:     useState<number | null>(null);
  151:   const [integrityWarning, setIntegrityWarning] = useState("");
  152:   const [integrityTerminated, setIntegrityTerminated] = useState(false);
  153:   const [integrityTerminationReason, setIntegrityTerminationReason] =
  154:     useState("");
  155: 
  156:   const deliveryMode: QuizDeliveryMode =
  157:     linkedAssignment?.deliveryMode ?? "practice";
  158:   const assessmentMode =
  159:     Boolean(assignmentId) && deliveryMode === "assessment";
  160: 
  161:   const currentQuestion = quiz.questions[currentIndex];
  162:   const selectedAnswer = currentQuestion
  163:     ? answers[currentQuestion.id] || ""
  164:     : "";
  165: 
  166:   const currentQuestionNumber = currentIndex + 1;
  167: 
  168:   const progress = Math.round(
  169:     ((currentIndex + 1) / Math.max(1, quiz.questions.length)) * 100,
  170:   );
  171: 
  172:   const totalXP = useMemo(() => {
  173:     return quiz.questions.reduce(
  174:       (total, question) => total + question.xpReward,
  175:       0,
  176:     );
  177:   }, [quiz.questions]);
  178: 
  179:   const correctCount = quiz.questions.filter((question) => {
  180:     const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  181:     const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  182:     return userAnswer === correctAnswer;
  183:   }).length;
  184: 
  185:   const scorePercent = Math.round(
  186:     (correctCount / Math.max(1, quiz.questions.length)) * 100,
  187:   );
  188: 
  189:   const earnedXP = quiz.questions.reduce((total, question) => {
  190:     const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  191:     const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  192: 
  193:     return userAnswer === correctAnswer
  194:       ? total + question.xpReward
  195:       : total;
  196:   }, 0);
  197: 
  198:   /*
  199:    * Integrity-terminated assessment attempts retain their raw score for
  200:    * teacher evidence, but do not award XP.
  201:    */
  202:   const awardedXP = integrityTerminated ? 0 : earnedXP;
  203: 
  204:   const strengths = quiz.questions
  205:     .filter((question) => {
  206:       const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  207:       const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  208:       return userAnswer === correctAnswer;
  209:     })
  210:     .slice(0, 3);
  211: 
  212:   const needsPractice = quiz.questions
  213:     .filter((question) => {
  214:       const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  215:       const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  216:       return userAnswer !== correctAnswer;
  217:     })
  218:     .slice(0, 3);
  219: 
  220:   useEffect(() => {
  221:     let cancelled = false;
  222: 
  223:     async function loadLinkedAssignment() {
  224:       if (!assignmentId) {
  225:         setLinkedAssignment(null);
  226:         setAssignmentLoading(false);
  227:         return;
  228:       }
  229: 
  230:       try {
  231:         setAssignmentLoading(true);
  232:         setAssignmentError("");
  233: 
  234:         const snapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "assignments", assignmentId));
  235: 
  236:         if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  237:           throw new Error("The linked quiz assignment could not be found.");
  238:         }
  239: 
  240:         const data = snapshot.data();
  241: 
  242:         if (data.type !== "quiz") {
  243:           throw new Error("This assignment is not a quiz assignment.");
  244:         }
  245: 
  246:         if (!data.classId || !data.teacherId) {
  247:           throw new Error(
  248:             "The assignment is missing its class or teacher information.",
  249:           );
  250:         }
  251: 
  252:         if (!cancelled) {
  253:           setLinkedAssignment({
  254:             id: snapshot.id,
  255:             classId: data.classId,
  256:             teacherId: data.teacherId,
  257:             resourceId: data.resourceId || quiz.topicId,
  258:             deliveryMode:
  259:               data.deliveryMode === "assessment" ? "assessment" : "practice",
  260:           });
  261:         }
  262:       } catch (error) {
  263:         console.error("Quiz assignment load error:", error);
  264: 
  265:         if (!cancelled) {
  266:           setAssignmentError(
  267:             error instanceof Error
  268:               ? error.message
  269:               : "The linked quiz assignment could not be loaded.",
  270:           );
  271:         }
  272:       } finally {
  273:         if (!cancelled) {
  274:           setAssignmentLoading(false);
  275:         }
  276:       }
  277:     }
  278: 
  279:     void loadLinkedAssignment();
  280: 
  281:     return () => {
  282:       cancelled = true;
  283:     };
  284:   }, [assignmentId, quiz.topicId]);
  285: 
  286:   useEffect(() => {
  287:     setTimeLeft(quizDurationSeconds);
  288:   }, [quiz.id, quizDurationSeconds]);
  289: 
  290:   useEffect(() => {
  291:     return () => {
  292:       if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  293:         clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  294:       }
  295:     };

  320:   async function finishQuiz({
  321:     terminated = false,
  322:     reason = "",
  323:   }: {
  324:     terminated?: boolean;
  325:     reason?: string;
  326:   } = {}) {
  327:     if (finishingRef.current || showResults) {
  328:       return;
  329:     }
  330: 
  331:     finishingRef.current = true;
  332: 
  333:     if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  334:       clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  335:       countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  336:     }
  337: 
  338:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current = false;
  339:     setFullscreenCountdown(null);
  340: 
  341:     if (terminated) {
  342:       /*
  343:        * Set the ref first so save effects see termination synchronously,
  344:        * before React finishes applying the state update.
  345:        */
  346:       integrityTerminatedRef.current = true;
  347:       setIntegrityTerminated(true);
  348:       setIntegrityTerminationReason(reason);
  349: 
  350:       appendIntegrityIncident(
  351:         "auto_submit",
  352:         reason || "The assessment was automatically submitted.",
  353:       );
  354:     }
  355: 
  356:     await leaveFullscreenSafely();
  357:     setShowResults(true);
  358:   }

  366:       return;
  367:     }
  368: 
  369:     const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
  370:       setTimeLeft((previousTime) => {
  371:         if (previousTime <= 1) {
  372:           window.clearInterval(timer);
  373: 
  374:           void finishQuiz({
  375:             terminated: assessmentMode,
  376:             reason: assessmentMode
  377:               ? "The assessment timer expired and the quiz was automatically submitted."
  378:               : "",
  379:           });
  380: 
  381:           return 0;
  382:         }
  383: 
  384:         return previousTime - 1;
  385:       });
  386:     }, 1000);
  387: 
  388:     return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  389:   }, [
  390:     showResults,
  391:     assignmentLoading,
  392:     assessmentMode,
  393:     integrityStarted,
  394:   ]);

  396:   function beginFullscreenCountdown() {
  397:     if (
  398:       !assessmentMode ||
  399:       !integrityStarted ||
  400:       showResults ||
  401:       finishingRef.current ||
  402:       fullscreenExitActiveRef.current
  403:     ) {
  404:       return;
  405:     }
  406: 
  407:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current = true;
  408: 
  409:     setFullscreenCountdown(FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS);
  410: 
  411:     appendIntegrityIncident(
  412:       "fullscreen_exit",
  413:       `Fullscreen was exited. A ${FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS}-second return countdown started.`,
  414:     );
  415: 
  416:     let remaining = FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS;
  417: 
  418:     countdownTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
  419:       remaining -= 1;
  420:       setFullscreenCountdown(Math.max(remaining, 0));
  421: 
  422:       if (remaining <= 0) {
  423:         if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  424:           clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  425:           countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  426:         }
  427: 
  428:         void finishQuiz({
  429:           terminated: true,
  430:           reason:
  431:             "The learner exited fullscreen and did not return within 5 seconds.",
  432:         });
  433:       }
  434:     }, 1000);
  435:   }

  437:   function resolveFullscreenExit() {
  438:     if (!fullscreenExitActiveRef.current) {
  439:       return;
  440:     }
  441: 
  442:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current = false;
  443: 
  444:     if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  445:       clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  446:       countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  447:     }
  448: 
  449:     setFullscreenCountdown(null);
  450: 
  451:     appendIntegrityIncident(
  452:       "fullscreen_restored",
  453:       "Fullscreen was restored before the five-second termination countdown expired.",
  454:     );
  455:   }
  456: 
  457:   useEffect(() => {
  458:     if (
  459:       !assessmentMode ||
  460:       !integrityStarted ||
  461:       showResults
  462:     ) {
  463:       return;
  464:     }
  465: 
  466:     function onFullscreenChange() {
  467:       if (finishingRef.current) {
  468:         return;
  469:       }
  470: 
  471:       if (
  472:         document.fullscreenElement ===
  473:         assessmentRootRef.current
  474:       ) {
  475:         resolveFullscreenExit();
  476:       } else {
  477:         beginFullscreenCountdown();
  478:       }
  479:     }
  480: 
  481:     function onVisibilityChange() {
  482:       if (finishingRef.current) {
  483:         return;
  484:       }
  485: 
  486:       if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") {
  487:         appendIntegrityIncident(
  488:           "page_hidden",
  489:           "The assessment page became hidden.",
  490:         );
  491: 
  492:         setIntegrityWarning(
  493:           "The assessment page was hidden. This incident has been recorded.",
  494:         );
  495:       } else {
  496:         appendIntegrityIncident(
  497:           "page_visible",
  498:           "The assessment page became visible again.",
  499:         );
  500:       }
  501:     }
  502: 
  503:     document.addEventListener(
  504:       "fullscreenchange",
  505:       onFullscreenChange,
  506:     );
  507:     document.addEventListener(
  508:       "visibilitychange",
  509:       onVisibilityChange,
  510:     );
  511: 
  512:     return () => {
  513:       document.removeEventListener(
  514:         "fullscreenchange",
  515:         onFullscreenChange,
  516:       );
  517:       document.removeEventListener(
  518:         "visibilitychange",
  519:         onVisibilityChange,
  520:       );
  521:     };
  522:   }, [
  523:     assessmentMode,
  524:     integrityStarted,
  525:     showResults,
  526:     currentIndex,
  527:   ]);

  529:   async function enterAssessmentMode() {

  531:       return;

  734:     if (assessmentMode && !integrityStarted) {

  736:     }

  744:   function goNext() {
  745:     if (currentIndex < quiz.questions.length - 1) {
  746:       setCurrentIndex((previousIndex) => previousIndex + 1);
  747:       setIntegrityWarning("");
  748:       return;
  749:     }
  750: 
  751:     void finishQuiz();
  752:   }

  757:       setIntegrityWarning("");
  758:     }
  759:   }
  760: 
  761:   if (assignmentLoading) {

  764:         <p className="font-bold text-slate-700">
  765:           Preparing your assigned quiz...
  766:         </p>
  767:       </Card>
  768:     );
  769:   }
  770: 
  771:   if (assignmentError) {

   24: function createSortedValues(length: number): number[] {
   25:   const values = new Set<number>();
   26: 
   27:   while (values.size < length) {
   28:     values.add(Math.floor(Math.random() * 90) + 10);
   29:   }
   30: 
   31:   return Array.from(values).sort((a, b) => a - b);
   32: }
   33: 
   34: function createQuestion(difficulty: DifficultyLevel): Question {
   35:   const length =
   36:     difficulty === "foundation" ? 7 : difficulty === "intermediate" ? 9 : 11;
   37: 
   38:   const values = createSortedValues(length);
   39: 
   40:   const allowMissing = difficulty !== "foundation" && Math.random() < 0.25;
   41: 
   42:   if (allowMissing) {
   43:     let target = Math.floor(Math.random() * 90) + 10;
   44: 
   45:     while (values.includes(target)) {
   46:       target = Math.floor(Math.random() * 90) + 10;
   47:     }
   48: 
   49:     return {
   50:       values,
   51:       target,
   52:     };
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   return {
   56:     values,
   57:     target: values[Math.floor(Math.random() * values.length)],
   58:   };
   59: }
   60: 
   61: function createWorking(question: Question): string {
   62:   let low = 0;
   63:   let high = question.values.length - 1;
   64: 
   65:   const steps: string[] = [];
   66: 
   67:   while (low <= high) {
   68:     const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
   69:     const middleValue = question.values[middle];
   70: 
   71:     steps.push(`Search area: index ${low} to ${high}`);
   72: 
   73:     steps.push(`Middle index = ${middle}, value = ${middleValue}`);
   74: 
   75:     if (middleValue === question.target) {
   76:       steps.push(
   77:         `${middleValue} equals ${question.target}, so the target is found at index ${middle}.`,
   78:       );
   79: 
   80:       return steps.join("\n\n");
   81:     }
   82: 
   83:     if (question.target < middleValue) {
   84:       steps.push(
   85:         `${question.target} is smaller than ${middleValue}, so discard the right half.`,
   86:       );
   87: 
   88:       high = middle - 1;
   89:     } else {
   90:       steps.push(
   91:         `${question.target} is larger than ${middleValue}, so discard the left half.`,
   92:       );
   93: 
   94:       low = middle + 1;
   95:     }
   96:   }
   97: 
   98:   steps.push("The search area is empty, so the target is not present.");
   99: 
  100:   return steps.join("\n\n");
  101: }
  102: 
  103: export default function BinarySearchSimulator() {
  104:   const { addXP } = useProgress();
  105: 
  106:   const simulator = useSimulator<Question>({
  107:     initialQuestion: createQuestion("foundation"),
  108:     generateQuestion: createQuestion,
  109: 
  110:     xpByDifficulty: {
  111:       foundation: 10,
  112:       intermediate: 15,
  113:       higher: 20,
  114:     },
  115: 
  116:     onAwardXP: addXP,
  117:   });
  118: 
  119:   const {
  120:     difficulty,
  121:     question,
  122: 
  123:     checked,
  124:     correct,
  125: 
  126:     hintVisible,
  127:     workingVisible,
  128: 
  129:     attempts,
  130:     correctAnswers,
  131:     accuracy,
  132:     xp,
  133:     streak,
  134: 
  135:     markAnswer,
  136:     resetQuestion,
  137:     newQuestion,
  138:     changeDifficulty,
  139: 
  140:     toggleHint,
  141:     toggleWorking,
  142:   } = simulator;
  143: 
  144:   /*
  145:    * =========================================================
  146:    * SCORED CHALLENGE
  147:    * =========================================================
  148:    */
  149: 
  150:   const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
  151: 
  152:   const expectedIndex = question.values.indexOf(question.target);
  153: 
  154:   const numericAnswer = Number(answer);
  155: 
  156:   const canCheck = answer.trim() !== "" && Number.isInteger(numericAnswer);
  157: 
  158:   function handleCheck() {
  159:     if (!canCheck) {
  160:       return;
  161:     }
  162: 
  163:     markAnswer(numericAnswer === expectedIndex);
  164:   }
  165: 
  166:   function handleTryAgain() {
  167:     setAnswer("");
  168:     resetQuestion();
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   const working = useMemo(() => createWorking(question), [question]);
  172: 
  173:   /*
  174:    * =========================================================
  175:    * PROCEDURAL TRAINER
  176:    * =========================================================
  177:    */
  178: 
  179:   const [low, setLow] = useState(0);
  180: 
  181:   const [high, setHigh] = useState(question.values.length - 1);
  182: 
  183:   const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
  184: 
  185:   const [procedureComplete, setProcedureComplete] = useState(false);
  186: 
  187:   const [foundProcedurally, setFoundProcedurally] = useState(false);
  188: 
  189:   const [procedureCorrectSteps, setProcedureCorrectSteps] = useState(0);
  190: 
  191:   const [procedureMistakes, setProcedureMistakes] = useState(0);
  192: 
  193:   const [discardCount, setDiscardCount] = useState(0);
  194: 
  195:   const [procedureFeedback, setProcedureFeedback] = useState("");
  196: 
  197:   const [procedureFeedbackType, setProcedureFeedbackType] =
  198:     useState<ProcedureFeedbackType>(null);
  199: 
  200:   /*
  201:    * Keep the procedural search bounds synchronised with the latest
  202:    * generated question. This fixes the temporary LOW=0, HIGH=0,
  203:    * MIDDLE=0 state after changing difficulty or creating a new question.
  204:    */
  205:   useEffect(() => {
  206:     setLow(0);
  207:     setHigh(question.values.length - 1);
  208:     setSelectedIndex(null);
  209:     setProcedureComplete(false);
  210:     setFoundProcedurally(false);
  211:     setProcedureCorrectSteps(0);
  212:     setProcedureMistakes(0);
  213:     setDiscardCount(0);
  214:     setProcedureFeedback("");
  215:     setProcedureFeedbackType(null);
  216:   }, [question]);
  217: 
  218:   const safeHigh =
  219:     high >= question.values.length ? question.values.length - 1 : high;
  220: 
  221:   const middle = low <= safeHigh ? Math.floor((low + safeHigh) / 2) : -1;
  222: 
  223:   const middleValue = middle >= 0 ? question.values[middle] : undefined;
  224: 
  225:   const procedureAttempts = procedureCorrectSteps + procedureMistakes;
  226: 
  227:   const procedureAccuracy =
  228:     procedureAttempts === 0
  229:       ? 0
  230:       : Math.round((procedureCorrectSteps / procedureAttempts) * 100);
  231: 
  232:   function resetProcedure() {
  233:     setLow(0);
  234:     setHigh(question.values.length - 1);
  235: 
  236:     setSelectedIndex(null);
  237: 
  238:     setProcedureComplete(false);
  239:     setFoundProcedurally(false);
  240: 
  241:     setProcedureCorrectSteps(0);
  242:     setProcedureMistakes(0);
  243:     setDiscardCount(0);
  244: 
  245:     setProcedureFeedback("");
  246:     setProcedureFeedbackType(null);
  247:   }
  248: 
  249:   function handleNewQuestion() {
  250:     setAnswer("");
  251: 
  252:     setLow(0);
  253:     setHigh(question.values.length - 1);
  254: 
  255:     setSelectedIndex(null);
  256: 
  257:     setProcedureComplete(false);
  258:     setFoundProcedurally(false);
  259: 
  260:     setProcedureCorrectSteps(0);
  261:     setProcedureMistakes(0);
  262:     setDiscardCount(0);
  263: 
  264:     setProcedureFeedback("");
  265:     setProcedureFeedbackType(null);
  266: 
  267:     newQuestion();
  268:   }
  269: 
  270:   function handleDifficultyChange(nextDifficulty: DifficultyLevel) {
  271:     setAnswer("");
  272: 
  273:     setLow(0);
  274:     setHigh(question.values.length - 1);
  275: 
  276:     setSelectedIndex(null);
  277: 
  278:     setProcedureComplete(false);
  279:     setFoundProcedurally(false);
  280: 
  281:     setProcedureCorrectSteps(0);
  282:     setProcedureMistakes(0);
  283:     setDiscardCount(0);
  284: 
  285:     setProcedureFeedback("");
  286:     setProcedureFeedbackType(null);
  287: 
  288:     changeDifficulty(nextDifficulty);
  289:   }
  290: 
  291:   function initialiseProcedureIfNeeded() {
  292:     if (high !== question.values.length - 1 && high !== 0) {
  293:       return;
  294:     }
  295: 
  296:     /*
  297:      * When a newly generated question has a different list length,
  298:      * the old high value may temporarily be 0.
  299:      */
  300:     if (
  301:       low === 0 &&
  302:       high === 0 &&
  303:       question.values.length > 1 &&
  304:       !procedureComplete &&
  305:       procedureCorrectSteps === 0 &&
  306:       discardCount === 0
  307:     ) {
  308:       setHigh(question.values.length - 1);
  309:     }
  310:   }
  311: 
  312:   function recordMistake(message: string) {
  313:     setProcedureMistakes((current) => current + 1);
  314:     setProcedureFeedback(message);
  315:     setProcedureFeedbackType("error");
  316:   }
  317: 
  318:   function recordSuccess(message: string) {
  319:     setProcedureCorrectSteps((current) => current + 1);
  320:     setProcedureFeedback(message);
  321:     setProcedureFeedbackType("success");
  322:   }
  323: 
  324:   function selectMiddle(index: number) {
  325:     if (difficulty === "foundation" || procedureComplete) {
  326:       return;
  327:     }
  328: 
  329:     initialiseProcedureIfNeeded();
  330: 
  331:     setSelectedIndex(index);
  332:     setProcedureFeedback("");
  333:     setProcedureFeedbackType(null);
  334:   }
  335: 
  336:   function validateMiddleSelection(): boolean {
  337:     if (difficulty === "foundation") {
  338:       return true;
  339:     }
  340: 
  341:     if (selectedIndex === null) {
  342:       recordMistake("Select the middle item of the current search area first.");
  343: 
  344:       return false;
  345:     }
  346: 
  347:     if (selectedIndex < low || selectedIndex > safeHigh) {
  348:       recordMistake(
  349:         `Index ${selectedIndex} is outside the current search area.`,
  350:       );
  351: 
  352:       return false;
  353:     }
  354: 
  355:     if (selectedIndex !== middle) {
  356:       recordMistake(
  357:         `That is not the correct middle index. The current search area runs from ${low} to ${safeHigh}.`,
  358:       );
  359: 
  360:       return false;
  361:     }
  362: 
  363:     return true;
  364:   }
  365: 
  366:   function completeNotFound() {
  367:     setProcedureComplete(true);
  368:     setFoundProcedurally(false);
  369: 
  370:     setProcedureFeedback(
  371:       "The search area is now empty. The target is not present.",
  372:     );
  373: 
  374:     setProcedureFeedbackType("success");
  375:   }
  376: 
  377:   function handleSearchLeft() {
  378:     if (procedureComplete) {
  379:       return;
  380:     }
  381: 
  382:     initialiseProcedureIfNeeded();
  383: 
  384:     if (!validateMiddleSelection()) {
  385:       return;
  386:     }
  387: 
  388:     if (middleValue === undefined) {
  389:       return;
  390:     }
  391: 
  392:     if (middleValue === question.target) {
  393:       recordMistake(
  394:         `${middleValue} equals the target. Do not discard either half â€” the target has been found.`,
  395:       );
  396: 
  397:       return;
  398:     }
  399: 
  400:     if (question.target > middleValue) {
  401:       recordMistake(
  402:         `${question.target} is greater than ${middleValue}. The target cannot be in the left half.`,
  403:       );
  404: 
  405:       return;
  406:     }
  407: 
  408:     recordSuccess(
  409:       `Correct. ${question.target} < ${middleValue}, so discard the middle value and everything to its right.`,
  410:     );
  411: 
  412:     setDiscardCount((current) => current + 1);
  413: 
  414:     const nextHigh = middle - 1;
  415: 
  416:     setHigh(nextHigh);
  417:     setSelectedIndex(null);
  418: 
  419:     if (low > nextHigh) {
  420:       setTimeout(() => {
  421:         completeNotFound();
  422:       }, 0);
  423:     }
  424:   }
  425: 
  426:   function handleSearchRight() {
  427:     if (procedureComplete) {
  428:       return;
  429:     }
  430: 
  431:     initialiseProcedureIfNeeded();
  432: 
  433:     if (!validateMiddleSelection()) {
  434:       return;
  435:     }
  436: 
  437:     if (middleValue === undefined) {
  438:       return;
  439:     }
  440: 
  441:     if (middleValue === question.target) {
  442:       recordMistake(
  443:         `${middleValue} equals the target. Do not discard either half â€” the target has been found.`,
  444:       );
  445: 
  446:       return;
  447:     }
  448: 
  449:     if (question.target < middleValue) {
  450:       recordMistake(
  451:         `${question.target} is smaller than ${middleValue}. The target cannot be in the right half.`,
  452:       );
  453: 
  454:       return;
  455:     }
  456: 
  457:     recordSuccess(
  458:       `Correct. ${question.target} > ${middleValue}, so discard the middle value and everything to its left.`,
  459:     );
  460: 
  461:     setDiscardCount((current) => current + 1);
  462: 
  463:     const nextLow = middle + 1;
  464: 
  465:     setLow(nextLow);
  466:     setSelectedIndex(null);
  467: 
  468:     if (nextLow > safeHigh) {
  469:       setTimeout(() => {
  470:         completeNotFound();
  471:       }, 0);
  472:     }
  473:   }
  474: 
  475:   function handleFound() {
  476:     if (procedureComplete) {
  477:       return;
  478:     }
  479: 
  480:     initialiseProcedureIfNeeded();
  481: 
  482:     if (!validateMiddleSelection()) {
  483:       return;
  484:     }
  485: 
  486:     if (middleValue === undefined) {
  487:       return;
  488:     }
  489: 
  490:     if (middleValue !== question.target) {
  491:       recordMistake(
  492:         `${middleValue} does not equal ${question.target}, so the target has not been found.`,
  493:       );
  494: 
  495:       return;
  496:     }
  497: 
  498:     setProcedureCorrectSteps((current) => current + 1);
  499: 
  500:     setProcedureFeedback(
  501:       `Correct. ${middleValue} equals ${question.target}. The target is at index ${middle}.`,
  502:     );
  503: 
  504:     setProcedureFeedbackType("success");
  505: 
  506:     setFoundProcedurally(true);
  507:     setProcedureComplete(true);
  508:   }
  509: 
  510:   /*
  511:    * Foundation still needs a Found action because otherwise a student could
  512:    * only choose left/right when the middle already equals the target.
  513:    */
  514: 
  515:   return (
  516:     <section className="space-y-8 rounded-3xl border border-indigo-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm md:p-8">
  517:       <header>
  518:         <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-indigo-600">
  519:           Algorithm laboratory
  520:         </p>
  521: 
  522:         <h2 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-black text-slate-950">
  523:           Binary Search Challenge
  524:         </h2>
  525: 
  526:         <p className="mt-3 max-w-3xl leading-7 text-slate-600">
  527:           Predict the target position, then perform Binary Search by selecting
  528:           middle values and repeatedly discarding the correct half.
  529:         </p>
  530:       </header>
  531: 
  532:       <SimulatorDifficulty
  533:         value={difficulty}
  534:         onChange={handleDifficultyChange}
  535:       />
  536: 
  537:       <SimulatorStats
  538:         attempts={attempts}
  539:         correct={correctAnswers}
  540:         accuracy={accuracy}
  541:         xp={xp}
  542:         streak={streak}
  543:       />
  544: 
  545:       {/* ==================================================== */}
  546:       {/* SCORED CHALLENGE                                     */}
  547:       {/* ==================================================== */}
  548: 
  549:       <section className="rounded-3xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 p-6">
  550:         <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-indigo-600">
  551:           Final-answer challenge
  552:         </p>
  553: 
  554:         <h3 className="mt-2 text-xl font-black">
  555:           At which index will {question.target} be found?
  556:         </h3>
  557: 
  558:         <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-600">
  559:           The list is sorted. Enter -1 if the target is not present.
  560:         </p>
  561: 
  562:         <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
  563:           {question.values.map((value, index) => (
  564:             <div
  565:               key={`${value}-${index}`}
  566:               className="rounded-2xl bg-white px-5 py-4 text-center"
  567:             >
  568:               <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">{index}</p>
  569:

  571:             </div>
  572:           ))}
  573:         </div>
  574:       </section>
  575: 
  576:       <section className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-6">
  577:         <label htmlFor="binary-search-answer" className="font-black">
  578:           Your answer
  579:         </label>
  580: 
  581:         <input
  582:           id="binary-search-answer"
  583:           type="number"
  584:           value={answer}
  585:           disabled={checked}
  586:           onChange={(event) => setAnswer(event.target.value)}
  587:           placeholder="Enter the index"
  588:           className="mt-3 w-full rounded-2xl border border-slate-300 px-5 py-4 text-xl font-black outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 disabled:bg-slate-100"
  589:         />
  590: 
  591:         <div className="mt-5">
  592:           <SimulatorControls
  593:             canCheck={canCheck}
  594:             checked={checked}
  595:             hintVisible={hintVisible}
  596:             workingVisible={workingVisible}
  597:             resetLabel="Try again"
  598:             newExampleLabel="New question"
  599:             onCheck={handleCheck}
  600:             onHint={toggleHint}
  601:             onToggleWorking={toggleWorking}
  602:             onReset={handleTryAgain}
  603:             onNewExample={handleNewQuestion}
  604:           />
  605:         </div>
  606:       </section>
  607:

  609:         checked={checked}

  611:         successMessage={
