  613:             ? "Correct. The target is not present, so the answer is -1."
  614:             : `Correct. The target is at index ${expectedIndex}.`
  615:         }
  616:         errorMessage={`Not quite. The correct answer is ${expectedIndex}.`}
  617:         hintVisible={hintVisible}
  618:         hint="Find the middle item. If the target is smaller, keep the left half. If it is larger, keep the right half."
  619:         workingVisible={workingVisible}
  620:         working={working}
  621:         examinerTip="Binary Search requires sorted data. Each successful decision removes roughly half of the remaining search area."
  622:       />
  623: 
  624:       {/* ==================================================== */}
  625:       {/* PROCEDURAL TRAINER                                   */}
  626:       {/* ==================================================== */}
  627: 
  628:       <div className="border-t border-slate-200 pt-8">
  629:         <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-violet-600">
  630:           Hands-on algorithm practice
  631:         </p>
  632: 
  633:         <h3 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">Perform Binary Search</h3>
  634: 
  635:         <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl leading-7 text-slate-600">
  636:           Identify the middle item, compare it with the target and decide which
  637:           half of the remaining search area can be discarded.
  638:         </p>
  639:

  644:             </p>

  675:           <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-4">

  677:               <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-violet-600">
  678:                 Target
  679:               </p>
  680: 
  681:               <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">{question.target}</p>
  682:             </div>
  683: 
  684:             <div>
  685:               <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-violet-600">
  686:                 Low
  687:               </p>
  688: 
  689:               <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">
  690:                 {procedureComplete ? "â€”" : low}
  691:               </p>
  692:             </div>
  693: 
  694:             <div>
  695:               <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-violet-600">
  696:                 High
  697:               </p>
  698: 
  699:               <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">
  700:                 {procedureComplete ? "â€”" : safeHigh}
  701:               </p>
  702:             </div>
  703: 
  704:             <div>
  705:               <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-violet-600">
  706:                 Middle
  707:               </p>
  708: 
  709:               <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">
  710:                 {procedureComplete ? "Complete" : middle}
  711:               </p>
  712:             </div>
  713:           </div>
  714:         </section>
  715: 
  716:         <div className="mt-6 rounded-3xl bg-slate-950 p-7">
  717:           <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-4">
  718:             {question.values.map((value, index) => {
  719:               const discarded = index < low || index > safeHigh;
  720: 
  721:               const automaticMiddle =
  722:                 difficulty === "foundation" &&
  723:                 index === middle &&
  724:                 !procedureComplete;
  725: 
  726:               const selected = selectedIndex === index;
  727: 
  728:               const found =
  729:                 procedureComplete &&
  730:                 foundProcedurally &&
  731:                 value === question.target;
  732:

  734:                 <button
  735:                   key={`${value}-${index}`}
  736:                   type="button"
  737:                   disabled={
  738:                     difficulty === "foundation" ||
  739:                     procedureComplete ||
  740:                     discarded
  741:                   }
  742:                   onClick={() => selectMiddle(index)}
  743:                   className={`relative flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border-2 text-2xl font-black transition ${
  744:                     found
  745:                       ? "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-500 text-white"
  746:                       : selected || automaticMiddle
  747:                         ? "border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-600 text-white"
  748:                         : discarded
  749:                           ? "border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 text-slate-600"
  750:                           : "border-slate-600 bg-slate-800 text-white hover:border-indigo-400"
  751:                   }`}
  752:                 >
  753:                   <span>{value}</span>
  754: 
  755:                   <span className="absolute -bottom-6 text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
  756:                     {index}
  757:                   </span>
  758:                 </button>
  759:               );
  760:             })}
  761:           </div>
  762: 
  763:           <div className="mt-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-300">
  764:             {procedureComplete ? (
  765:               foundProcedurally ? (
  766:                 <p className="font-black text-emerald-300">
  767:                   Target found. Binary Search complete.
  768:                 </p>
  769:               ) : (
  770:                 <p className="font-black text-amber-300">
  771:                   Search area empty. Target not found.
  772:                 </p>
  773:               )
  774:             ) : difficulty === "foundation" ? (
  775:               <p>
  776:                 The middle item is highlighted. Compare it with the target and
  777:                 choose the correct action.
  778:               </p>
  779:             ) : selectedIndex === null ? (
  780:               <p>Select the middle item of the current search area.</p>
  781:             ) : (

  797:             â† Search left

  821:             className="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-6 py-3 font-black"
  822:           >

  824:           </button>

  826:

  832:                 : procedureFeedbackType === "error"
  833:                   ? "border-red-300 bg-red-50 text-red-900"
  834:                   : "border-blue-300 bg-blue-50 text-blue-900"
  835:             }`}

  886:               </div>
  887:             </div>

  298:   function validateSelectedPair(): boolean {
  299:     if (difficulty === "foundation") {
  300:       return true;
  301:     }
  302: 
  303:     if (selectedIndices.length !== 2) {

  305:         "Select exactly two adjacent values before choosing Keep or Swap.",
  306:       );

  312: 
  313:     if (ordered[1] - ordered[0] !== 1) {
  314:       recordMistake(
  315:         "Bubble sort compares adjacent values only. Select two neighbouring items.",
  316:       );
  317: 
  318:       return false;
  319:     }
  320: 
  321:     if (ordered[0] !== pairLeft || ordered[1] !== pairRight) {
  322:       recordMistake(
  323:         `That is not the next comparison. Bubble sort must now compare index ${pairLeft} with index ${pairRight}.`,
  324:       );
  325: 
  326:       return false;
  327:     }

  329:     return true;

  332:   function advanceAfterCorrectDecision(didSwap: boolean, nextValues: number[]) {
  333:     const nextSwappedInPass = swappedInPass || didSwap;
  334: 
  335:     setProcedureValues(nextValues);
  336:     setSwappedInPass(nextSwappedInPass);

  339:     /*
  340:      * We have reached the end of the current pass.
  341:      */
  342:     if (currentPairIsLastInPass) {
  343:       /*
  344:        * Higher students must explicitly recognise the end of a pass.
  345:        */
  346:       if (difficulty === "higher") {
  347:         setAwaitingEndPass(true);
  348: 
  349:         setProcedureFeedback(
  350:           "Correct decision. You have reached the end of this pass. Decide what should happen next.",
  351:         );
  352:

  354: 
  355:         return;
  356:       }
  357: 
  358:       finishPass(nextSwappedInPass, nextValues);
  359: 
  360:       return;
  361:     }
  362: 
  363:     setCompareIndex((current) => current + 1);
  364:   }
  365: 
  366:   function finishPass(hadSwap: boolean, currentValues: number[]) {
  367:     setPassesCompleted((current) => current + 1);
  368:     setAwaitingEndPass(false);
  369:     setSelectedIndices([]);
  370: 
  371:     /*
  372:      * No swap during a complete pass means the list is sorted.
  373:      */
  374:     if (!hadSwap) {
  375:       setProcedureComplete(true);
  376: 
  377:       setProcedureFeedback(
  378:         "Excellent. A complete pass produced no swaps, so the list is sorted.",
  379:       );
  380: 
  381:       setProcedureFeedbackType("success");
  382: 
  383:       return;
  384:     }
  385: 
  386:     /*
  387:      * Every pass fixes at least one value at the right-hand side.
  388:      */
  389:     if (pass >= currentValues.length - 1) {
  390:       setProcedureComplete(true);
  391: 
  392:       setProcedureFeedback(
  393:         "Excellent. All required passes are complete and the list is sorted.",
  394:       );
  395: 
  396:       setProcedureFeedbackType("success");
  397: 
  398:       return;
  399:     }
  400: 
  401:     setPass((current) => current + 1);
  402:     setCompareIndex(0);
  403:     setSwappedInPass(false);
  404: 
  405:     setProcedureFeedback(
  406:       `Pass ${pass} complete. Begin pass ${pass + 1} from the left-hand side.`,
  407:     );
  408: 
  409:     setProcedureFeedbackType("success");
  410:   }
  411: 
  412:   function handleSwap() {
  413:     if (procedureComplete || awaitingEndPass) {
  414:       return;
  415:     }
  416: 
  417:     const currentValues = ensureProcedureInitialised();
  418: 
  419:     if (!validateSelectedPair()) {
  420:       return;
  421:     }
  422: 
  423:     const left = currentValues[pairLeft];
  424:     const right = currentValues[pairRight];
  425: 
  426:     if (left === undefined || right === undefined) {
  427:       return;
  428:     }
  429: 
  430:     if (left <= right) {
  431:       recordMistake(
  432:         `${left} is not greater than ${right}. These values are already in ascending order, so they should be kept.`,
  433:       );
  434: 
  435:       return;
  436:     }
  437: 
  438:     const nextValues = [...currentValues];
  439: 
  440:     [nextValues[pairLeft], nextValues[pairRight]] = [
  441:       nextValues[pairRight],
  442:       nextValues[pairLeft],
  443:     ];
  444: 
  445:     recordSuccess(
  446:       `Correct. ${left} > ${right}, so the adjacent values must be swapped.`,
  447:     );
  448: 
  449:     advanceAfterCorrectDecision(true, nextValues);
  450:   }
  451: 
  452:   function handleKeep() {
  453:     if (procedureComplete || awaitingEndPass) {
  454:       return;
  455:     }
  456: 
  457:     const currentValues = ensureProcedureInitialised();
  458: 
  459:     if (!validateSelectedPair()) {
  460:       return;
  461:     }
  462: 
  463:     const left = currentValues[pairLeft];
  464:     const right = currentValues[pairRight];
  465: 
  466:     if (left === undefined || right === undefined) {
  467:       return;
  468:     }
  469: 
  470:     if (left > right) {
  471:       recordMistake(
  472:         `${left} > ${right}. Bubble sort requires these adjacent values to be swapped.`,
  473:       );
  474: 
  475:       return;
  476:     }
  477: 
  478:     recordSuccess(
  479:       `Correct. ${left} â‰¤ ${right}, so the values remain in this order.`,
  480:     );
  481: 
  482:     advanceAfterCorrectDecision(false, [...currentValues]);
  483:   }
  484: 
  485:   function handleEndPass() {
  486:     if (difficulty !== "higher" || procedureComplete) {
  487:       return;
  488:     }
  489: 
  490:     if (!awaitingEndPass) {
  491:       recordMistake(
  492:         "The pass is not finished yet. Continue comparing the next adjacent pair.",
  493:       );
  494: 
  495:       return;
  496:     }
  497: 
  498:     setProcedureCorrectSteps((current) => current + 1);
  499: 
  500:     finishPass(
  501:       swappedInPass ||
  502:         /*
  503:          * If the final comparison was a swap, procedureValues has already
  504:          * changed. We can determine whether the current pass contained a
  505:          * swap by comparing against the sorted state through swappedInPass,
  506:          * but the final action may have been the first swap in the pass.
  507:          *
  508:          * The safest indicator is that the list at this point differs from
  509:          * the pass-start ordering only through valid swaps. For the purpose
  510:          * of early termination, a pass with any final swap must continue.
  511:          *
  512:          * currentPairIsLastInPass plus shouldSwap before mutation cannot be
  513:          * used here after state updates, so we conservatively treat an end
  514:          * pass as having swaps unless swappedInPass is false AND the list is
  515:          * currently sorted.
  516:          */
  517:         !displayedProcedureValues.every(
  518:           (value, index, array) => index === 0 || array[index - 1] <= value,
  519:         ),
  520:       displayedProcedureValues,
  521:     );
  522:   }
  523:

  391:             </div>
  392:           </div>
  393: 
  394:           <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-wrap gap-3">
  395:             <button
  396:               type="button"
  397:               onClick={onRegenerate}
  398:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-white/30 bg-white/10 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/20"
  399:             >
  400:               <RefreshCcw className="h-4 w-4" />
  401:               Regenerate
  402:             </button>
  403: 
  404:             <button
  405:               type="button"
  406:               onClick={onSave}
  407:               disabled={isSaving || isSaved}
  408:               className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-70"
  409:             >
  410:               {isSaving ? (
  411:                 <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
  412:               ) : isSaved ? (
  413:                 <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
  414:               ) : (
  415:                 <Save className="h-4 w-4" />
  416:               )}
  417: 
  418:               {isSaving
  419:                 ? "Saving..."
  420:                 : isSaved
  421:                   ? "Saved to Library"
  422:                   : "Save to Library"}
  423:             </button>
  424:           </div>
  425:         </div>
  426:       </section>
  427: 
  428:       <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
  429:         <PreviewCard
  430:           title="Learning objectives"
  431:           icon={<Target className="h-5 w-5" />}
  432:         >
  433:           <BulletList items={resource.learningObjectives} />
  434:         </PreviewCard>
  435: 
  436:         <PreviewCard
  437:           title="Success criteria"
  438:           icon={<CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5" />}
  439:         >
  440:           <BulletList items={resource.successCriteria} />
  441:         </PreviewCard>
  442:       </div>
  443: 
  444:       <PreviewCard
  445:         title="Resource sequence"
  446:         icon={<BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" />}
  447:       >
  448:         <div className="space-y-5">
  449:           {resource.sections.map((section, index) => (
  450:             <article
  451:               key={`${section.title}-${index}`}
  452:               className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200"
  453:             >
  454:               <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-50 px-5 py-4">
  455:                 <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
  456:                   <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-sm font-bold text-white">
  457:                     {index + 1}
  458:                   </span>
  459: 
  460:                   <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900">{section.title}</h4>
  461:                 </div>
  462: 
  463:                 <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">
  464:                   {section.duration}
  465:                 </span>
  466:               </div>
  467: 
  468:               <div className="grid gap-5 p-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
  469:                 <div>
  470:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">
  471:                     Teacher instructions
  472:                   </h5>
  473:                   <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  474:                     {section.teacherInstructions}
  475:                   </p>
  476:                 </div>
  477: 
  478:                 <div>
  479:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">
  480:                     Student task
  481:                   </h5>
  482:                   <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  483:                     {section.studentTask}
  484:                   </p>
  485:                 </div>
  486: 
  487:                 <div>
  488:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">Assessment</h5>
  489:                   <p className="text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  490:                     {section.assessment}
  491:                   </p>
  492:                 </div>
  493: 
  494:                 <div>
  495:                   <h5 className="mb-2 font-bold text-slate-900">Resources</h5>
  496:                   <BulletList items={section.resources} />
  497:                 </div>
  498:               </div>
  499:             </article>
  500:           ))}
  501:         </div>
  502:       </PreviewCard>
  503: 
  504:       <PreviewCard title="Differentiation" icon={<Users className="h-5 w-5" />}>
  505:         <div className="grid gap-5 lg:grid-cols-3">
  506:           {[
  507:             ["Support", resource.differentiation.support],
  508:             ["Core", resource.differentiation.core],
  509:             ["Stretch", resource.differentiation.stretch],
  510:           ].map(([title, items]) => (
  511:             <div
  512:               key={title as string}
  513:               className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4"
  514:             >
  515:               <h4 className="mb-3 font-bold text-slate-900">
  516:                 {title as string}
  517:               </h4>
  518:               <BulletList items={items as string[]} />
  519:             </div>
  520:           ))}
  521:         </div>
  522:       </PreviewCard>
  523: 
  524:       <PreviewCard
  525:         title="Common misconceptions"
  526:         icon={<AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5" />}
  527:       >
  528:         <div className="space-y-4">
  529:           {resource.misconceptions.map((item, index) => (
  530:             <div
  531:               key={`${item.misconception}-${index}`}
  532:               className="rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4"
  533:             >
  534:               <p className="font-bold text-amber-950">{item.misconception}</p>
  535:               <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-700">
  536:                 {item.correction}
  537:               </p>
  538:             </div>
  539:           ))}
  540:         </div>
  541:       </PreviewCard>
  542: 
  543:       <PreviewCard
  544:         title="Assessment questions"
  545:         icon={<FileQuestion className="h-5 w-5" />}
  546:       >
  547:         <div className="space-y-4">
  548:           {resource.assessmentQuestions.map((question, index) => (
  549:             <details
  550:               key={`${question.question}-${index}`}
  551:               className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200"
  552:             >
  553:               <summary className="cursor-pointer bg-slate-50 px-4 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-900">
  554:                 {index + 1}. {question.question} ({question.marks}{" "}
  555:                 {question.marks === 1 ? "mark" : "marks"})
  556:               </summary>
  557: 
  558:               <div className="border-t border-slate-200 px-4 py-4 text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  559:                 <strong>Answer:</strong> {question.answer}
  560:               </div>
  561:             </details>
  562:           ))}
  563:         </div>
  564:       </PreviewCard>
  565: 
  566:       <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
  567:         <PreviewCard
  568:           title="Homework"
  569:           icon={<GraduationCap className="h-5 w-5" />}
  570:         >
  571:           <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  572:             {resource.homework}
  573:           </p>
  574:         </PreviewCard>
  575: 
  576:         <PreviewCard
  577:           title="Teacher notes"
  578:           icon={<Lightbulb className="h-5 w-5" />}
  579:         >
  580:           <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  581:             {resource.teacherNotes}
  582:           </p>
  583:         </PreviewCard>
  584:       </div>
  585:     </div>
  586:   );
  587: }
  588: 
  589: export default function ResourceBuilderForm({
  590:   resourceType,
  591:   initialValues = {},
  592:   prefillVersion = 0,
  593: }: ResourceBuilderFormProps) {
  594:   const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(DEFAULT_FORM);
  595: 
  596:   const [resource, setResource] = useState<GeneratedTeachingResource | null>(
  597:     null,
  598:   );
  599: 
  600:   const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  601: 
  602:   const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  603:   const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);
  604: 
  605:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  606: 
  607:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  608: 
  609:   const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  610: 
  611:   const previewRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  612: 
  613:   const resolvedResourceType = normaliseResourceType(resourceType);
  614: 
  615:   const resourceLabel = RESOURCE_LABELS[resolvedResourceType];
  616: 
  617:   useEffect(() => {
  618:     setForm({
  619:       ...DEFAULT_FORM,
  620:       ...initialValues,
  621:       duration: initialValues.duration ?? DEFAULT_FORM.duration,
  622:       difficulty: initialValues.difficulty ?? DEFAULT_FORM.difficulty,
  623:     });
  624: 
  625:     setResource(null);
  626:     setError(null);
  627:     setSuccess(null);
  628:     setIsSaved(false);
  629:   }, [resolvedResourceType, initialValues, prefillVersion]);
  630: 
  631:   useEffect(() => {
  632:     return () => {
  633:       abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  634:     };
  635:   }, []);
  636: 
  637:   function updateField<K extends keyof FormState>(
  638:     field: K,
  639:     value: FormState[K],
  640:   ) {
  641:     setForm((current) => ({
  642:       ...current,
  643:       [field]: value,
  644:     }));
  645: 
  646:     setError(null);
  647:     setSuccess(null);
  648:   }
  649: 
  650:   function validateForm(): string | null {
  651:     if (form.topic.trim().length < 2) {
  652:       return "Enter a topic with at least two characters.";
  653:     }
  654: 
  655:     const duration = Number(form.duration);
  656: 
  657:     if (!Number.isInteger(duration) || duration < 5 || duration > 180) {
  658:       return "Select a valid duration.";
  659:     }
  660: 
  661:     return null;
  662:   }
  663: 
  664:   async function generateResource() {
  665:     const validationError = validateForm();
  666: 
  667:     if (validationError) {
  668:       setError(validationError);
  669:       return;
  670:     }
  671: 
  672:     abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  673: 
  674:     const controller = new AbortController();
  675:     abortControllerRef.current = controller;
  676: 
  677:     setIsGenerating(true);
  678:     setError(null);
  679:     setSuccess(null);
  680:     setIsSaved(false);
  681: 
  682:     try {
  683:       const response = await fetch("/api/teacher/assistant", {
  684:         method: "POST",
  685:         headers: {
  686:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  687:         },
  688:         signal: controller.signal,
  689:         body: JSON.stringify({
  690:           resourceType: resolvedResourceType,
  691:           topic: form.topic.trim(),
  692:           yearGroup: form.yearGroup,
  693:           examBoard: form.examBoard,
  694:           duration: Number(form.duration),
  695:           difficulty: form.difficulty,
  696:           objectives: form.objectives.trim(),
  697:           additionalNotes: form.additionalNotes.trim(),
  698:         }),
  699:       });
  700: 
  701:       const data = (await response.json()) as GenerateResourceResponse;
  702: 
  703:       if (!response.ok) {
  704:         throw new Error(data.error || "The resource could not be generated.");
  705:       }
  706: 
  707:       if (!data.resource) {
  708:         throw new Error("The server did not return a resource.");
  709:       }
  710: 
  711:       setResource(data.resource);
  712: 
  713:       window.setTimeout(() => {
  714:         previewRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
  715:           behavior: "smooth",
  716:           block: "start",
  717:         });
  718:       }, 100);
  719:     } catch (caughtError) {
  720:       if (
  721:         caughtError instanceof DOMException &&
  722:         caughtError.name === "AbortError"
  723:       ) {
  724:         return;
  725:       }
  726: 
  727:       setError(
  728:         caughtError instanceof Error
  729:           ? caughtError.message
  730:           : "The resource could not be generated.",
  731:       );
  732:     } finally {
  733:       setIsGenerating(false);
  734:     }
  735:   }
  736: 
  737:   function loadDemoResource() {
  738:     const demoResource = createDemoResource(resolvedResourceType);
  739: 
  740:     setForm((current) => ({
  741:       ...current,
  742:       topic: "Binary addition",
  743:       yearGroup: "Year 10",
  744:       examBoard: "AQA",
  745:       duration: "60",
  746:       difficulty: "standard",
  747:     }));
  748: 
  749:     setResource(demoResource);
  750:     setError(null);
  751:     setSuccess(
  752:       "Demo resource loaded. You can now test saving it to Firestore.",
  753:     );
  754:     setIsSaved(false);
  755: 
  756:     window.setTimeout(() => {
  757:       previewRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
  758:         behavior: "smooth",
  759:         block: "start",
  760:       });
  761:     }, 100);
  762:   }
  763: 
  764:   async function handleSaveResource() {
  765:     if (!resource) {
  766:       setError("Generate or load a resource first.");
  767:       return;
  768:     }
  769: 
  770:     const teacher = auth.currentUser;
  771: 
  772:     if (!teacher) {
  773:       setError("You must be signed in as a teacher to save resources.");
  774:       return;
  775:     }
  776: 
  777:     setIsSaving(true);
  778:     setError(null);
  779:     setSuccess(null);
  780: 
  781:     try {
  782:       await saveTeacherResource(teacher.uid, resource);
  783: 
  784:       setIsSaved(true);
  785:       setSuccess("Resource saved successfully to your teacher library.");
  786:     } catch (caughtError) {
  787:       setError(
  788:         caughtError instanceof Error
  789:           ? caughtError.message
  790:           : "The resource could not be saved.",
  791:       );
  792:     } finally {
  793:       setIsSaving(false);
  794:     }
  795:   }
  796: 
  797:   async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
  798:     event.preventDefault();
  799:     await generateResource();
  800:   }
  801: 
  802:   return (
  803:     <div className="space-y-8">
  804:       <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
  805:         <div className="rounded-2xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50 p-4">
  806:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
  807:             <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white">
  808:               <WandSparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
  809:             </div>
  810: 
  811:             <div>
  812:               <p className="font-bold text-indigo-950">
  813:                 Creating: {resourceLabel}
  814:               </p>
  815: 
  816:               <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-indigo-800">
  817:                 Generate with GPT-5.6 or load the demo resource to test saving
  818:                 without API credits.
  819:               </p>
  820:             </div>
  821:           </div>
  822:         </div>
  823: 
  824:         <div>
  825:           <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-topic" required>
  826:             Topic
  827:           </FieldLabel>
  828: 
  829:           <input
  830:             id="assistant-topic"
  831:             value={form.topic}
  832:             onChange={(event) => updateField("topic", event.target.value)}
  833:             placeholder="For example: Binary addition"
  834:             maxLength={150}
  835:             disabled={isGenerating}
  836:             className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 disabled:bg-slate-100"
  837:           />
  838:         </div>
  839: 
  840:         <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
  841:           <div>
  842:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-year" required>
  843:               Year group or qualification
  844:             </FieldLabel>
  845: 
  846:             <div className="relative">
  847:               <select
  848:                 id="assistant-year"
  849:                 value={form.yearGroup}
  850:                 onChange={(event) =>
  851:                   updateField("yearGroup", event.target.value)
  852:                 }
  853:                 className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 pr-10 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  854:               >
  855:                 {YEAR_GROUPS.map((yearGroup) => (
  856:                   <option key={yearGroup} value={yearGroup}>
  857:                     {yearGroup}
  858:                   </option>
  859:                 ))}
  860:               </select>
  861: 
  862:               <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
  863:             </div>
  864:           </div>
  865: 
  866:           <div>
  867:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-board" required>
  868:               Exam board
  869:             </FieldLabel>
  870: 
  871:             <div className="relative">
  872:               <select
  873:                 id="assistant-board"
  874:                 value={form.examBoard}
  875:                 onChange={(event) =>
  876:                   updateField("examBoard", event.target.value)
  877:                 }
  878:                 className="w-full appearance-none rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 pr-10 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  879:               >
  880:                 {EXAM_BOARDS.map((examBoard) => (
  881:                   <option key={examBoard} value={examBoard}>
  882:                     {examBoard}
  883:                   </option>
  884:                 ))}
  885:               </select>
  886: 
  887:               <ChevronDown className="pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
  888:             </div>
  889:           </div>
  890:         </div>
  891: 
  892:         <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2">
  893:           <div>
  894:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-duration" required>
  895:               Duration
  896:             </FieldLabel>
  897: 
  898:             <select
  899:               id="assistant-duration"
  900:               value={form.duration}
  901:               onChange={(event) => updateField("duration", event.target.value)}
  902:               className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  903:             >
  904:               {DURATIONS.map(([value, label]) => (
  905:                 <option key={value} value={value}>
  906:                   {label}
  907:                 </option>
  908:               ))}
  909:             </select>
  910:           </div>
  911: 
  912:           <div>
  913:             <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-difficulty" required>
  914:               Difficulty
  915:             </FieldLabel>
  916: 
  917:             <select
  918:               id="assistant-difficulty"
  919:               value={form.difficulty}
  920:               onChange={(event) =>
  921:                 updateField(
  922:                   "difficulty",
  923:                   event.target.value as FormState["difficulty"],
  924:                 )
  925:               }
  926:               className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  927:             >
  928:               <option value="foundation">Foundation</option>
  929:               <option value="standard">Standard</option>
  930:               <option value="higher">Higher</option>
  931:             </select>
  932:           </div>
  933:         </div>
  934: 
  935:         <div>
  936:           <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-objectives">
  937:             Learning objectives
  938:           </FieldLabel>
  939: 
  940:           <textarea
  941:             id="assistant-objectives"
  942:             value={form.objectives}
  943:             onChange={(event) => updateField("objectives", event.target.value)}
  944:             rows={4}
  945:             maxLength={1500}
  946:             placeholder="Leave blank to generate suitable objectives."
  947:             className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-6 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  948:           />
  949:         </div>
  950: 
  951:         <div>
  952:           <FieldLabel htmlFor="assistant-notes">
  953:             Additional instructions
  954:           </FieldLabel>
  955: 
  956:           <textarea
  957:             id="assistant-notes"
  958:             value={form.additionalNotes}
  959:             onChange={(event) =>
  960:               updateField("additionalNotes", event.target.value)
  961:             }
  962:             rows={4}
  963:             maxLength={2000}
  964:             placeholder="For example: Include SEND scaffolding and an exam-style challenge."
  965:             className="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-6 outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100"
  966:           />
  967:         </div>
  968: 
  969:         {error && (
  970:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-800">
  971:             <AlertCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  972: 
  973:             <div>
  974:               <p className="font-bold">Action failed</p>
  975:               <p className="mt-1 text-sm">{error}</p>
  976:             </div>
  977:           </div>
  978:         )}
  979: 
  980:         {success && (
  981:           <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 p-4 text-emerald-800">
  982:             <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
  983: 
  984:             <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{success}</p>
  985:           </div>
  986:         )}
  987: 
  988:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
  989:           <button
  990:             type="submit"
  991:             disabled={isGenerating || form.topic.trim().length < 2}
  992:             className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300"
  993:           >
  994:             {isGenerating ? (
  995:               <>
  996:                 <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin" />
  997:                 Generating...
  998:               </>
  999:             ) : (
 1000:               <>
 1001:                 <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
 1002:                 Generate {resourceLabel}
 1003:                 <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
 1004:               </>
 1005:             )}
 1006:           </button>
 1007: 
 1008:           <button

====================================================================================================
FILE: hooks\useProgrammingProgress.ts
====================================================================================================

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
    4: 
    5: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
    6: import { useProgress } from "@/contexts/ProgressContext";
    7: import type {
    8:   ProgrammingChallenge,
    9:   ProgrammingProgressSnapshot,
   10:   ProgrammingSkill,
   11:   ProgrammingSkillProgress,
   12: } from "@/types/programming";
   13: 
   14: const LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY = "cs-master-programming-progress-v2";
   15: 
   16: function storageKey(studentId: string): string {
   17:   return `cs-master-programming-progress-v3:${studentId}`;
   18: }
   19: 
   20: const emptyProgress: ProgrammingProgressSnapshot = {
   21:   attempts: 0,
   22:   correct: 0,
   23:   xp: 0,
   24:   streak: 0,
   25:   bestStreak: 0,
   26:   completedChallengeIds: [],
   27:   history: [],
   28:   skillProgress: {},
   29: };
   30: 
   31: function loadProgress(studentId: string): ProgrammingProgressSnapshot {
   32:   if (typeof window === "undefined" || !studentId) return emptyProgress;
   33: 
   34:   try {
   35:     const scopedKey = storageKey(studentId);
   36:     const scoped = window.localStorage.getItem(scopedKey);
   37:     const legacy = window.localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
   38:     const raw = scoped ?? legacy;
   39: 
   40:     if (!raw) return emptyProgress;
   41: 
   42:     if (!scoped && legacy) {
   43:       window.localStorage.setItem(scopedKey, legacy);
   44:       window.localStorage.removeItem(LEGACY_STORAGE_KEY);
   45:     }
   46: 
   47:     const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<ProgrammingProgressSnapshot>;
   48: 
   49:     return {
   50:       ...emptyProgress,
   51:       ...parsed,
   52:       completedChallengeIds: Array.isArray(parsed.completedChallengeIds)
   53:         ? parsed.completedChallengeIds
   54:         : [],
   55:       history: Array.isArray(parsed.history) ? parsed.history : [],
   56:       skillProgress:
   57:         parsed.skillProgress && typeof parsed.skillProgress === "object"
   58:           ? parsed.skillProgress
   59:           : {},
   60:     };
   61:   } catch {
   62:     return emptyProgress;
   63:   }
   64: }
   65: 
   66: function updateSkillProgress(
   67:   current: Partial<Record<ProgrammingSkill, ProgrammingSkillProgress>>,
   68:   skills: ProgrammingSkill[],
   69:   passed: boolean,
   70: ): Partial<Record<ProgrammingSkill, ProgrammingSkillProgress>> {
   71:   const next = { ...current };
   72: 
   73:   for (const skill of skills) {
   74:     const existing = next[skill] ?? {
   75:       attempts: 0,
   76:       correct: 0,
   77:       accuracy: 0,
   78:     };
   79: 
   80:     const attempts = existing.attempts + 1;
   81:     const correct = existing.correct + (passed ? 1 : 0);
   82: 
   83:     next[skill] = {
   84:       attempts,
   85:       correct,
   86:       accuracy: Math.round((correct / attempts) * 100),
   87:     };
   88:   }
   89: 
   90:   return next;
   91: }
   92: 
   93: export function useProgrammingProgress() {
   94:   const { user } = useAuth();
   95:   const { addXP } = useProgress();
   96:   const studentId = user?.uid ?? "";
   97:   const [progress, setProgress] =
   98:     useState<ProgrammingProgressSnapshot>(emptyProgress);
   99:   const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState(false);
  100: 
  101:   useEffect(() => {
  102:     setHydrated(false);
  103:     setProgress(loadProgress(studentId));
  104:     setHydrated(Boolean(studentId));
  105:   }, [studentId]);
  106: 
  107:   useEffect(() => {
  108:     if (!hydrated || !studentId) return;
  109: 
  110:     window.localStorage.setItem(
  111:       storageKey(studentId),
  112:       JSON.stringify(progress),
  113:     );
  114:   }, [hydrated, progress, studentId]);
  115: 
  116:   const accuracy = useMemo(() => {
  117:     if (progress.attempts === 0) return 0;
  118: 
  119:     return Math.round(
  120:       (progress.correct / progress.attempts) * 100,
  121:     );
  122:   }, [progress.attempts, progress.correct]);
  123: 
  124:   const weakSkills = useMemo(() => {
  125:     return Object.entries(progress.skillProgress)
  126:       .filter(([, value]) => value && value.attempts >= 2)
  127:       .sort(
  128:         (a, b) =>
  129:           (a[1]?.accuracy ?? 100) - (b[1]?.accuracy ?? 100),
  130:       )
  131:       .slice(0, 4)
  132:       .map(([skill]) => skill as ProgrammingSkill);
  133:   }, [progress.skillProgress]);
  134: 
  135:   const recordAttempt = useCallback(
  136:     (challenge: ProgrammingChallenge, passed: boolean) => {
  137:       let awarded = 0;
  138: 
  139:       setProgress((current) => {
  140:         const alreadyCompleted =
  141:           current.completedChallengeIds.includes(challenge.id);
  142: 
  143:         awarded =
  144:           passed && !alreadyCompleted ? challenge.xpReward : 0;
  145: 
  146:         const nextStreak = passed ? current.streak + 1 : 0;
  147: 
  148:         return {
  149:           attempts: current.attempts + 1,
  150:           correct: current.correct + (passed ? 1 : 0),
  151:           xp: current.xp + awarded,
  152:           streak: nextStreak,
  153:           bestStreak: Math.max(current.bestStreak, nextStreak),
  154:           completedChallengeIds:
  155:             passed && !alreadyCompleted
  156:               ? [...current.completedChallengeIds, challenge.id]
  157:               : current.completedChallengeIds,
  158:           skillProgress: updateSkillProgress(
  159:             current.skillProgress,
  160:             challenge.skills,
  161:             passed,
  162:           ),
  163:           history: [
  164:             {
  165:               id: `${challenge.id}-${Date.now()}`,
  166:               challengeId: challenge.id,
  167:               challengeTitle: challenge.title,
  168:               mode: challenge.mode,
  169:               difficulty: challenge.difficulty,
  170:               skills: challenge.skills,
  171:               passed,
  172:               xpAwarded: awarded,
  173:               createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  174:             },
  175:             ...current.history,
  176:           ].slice(0, 50),
  177:         };
  178:       });
  179: 
  180:       if (awarded > 0) {
  181:         addXP(awarded);
  182:       }
  183: 
  184:       return awarded;
  185:     },
  186:     [addXP],
  187:   );
  188: 
  189:   const resetProgrammingProgress = useCallback(() => {
  190:     setProgress(emptyProgress);
  191:   }, []);
  192: 
  193:   return {
  194:     ...progress,
  195:     hydrated,
  196:     accuracy,
  197:     weakSkills,
  198:     recordAttempt,
  199:     resetProgrammingProgress,
  200:   };
  201: }
